title: Principal Consultant - Project Management
description:
**The Opportunity**

Our UK Water business is growing fast — and we’re looking for a Principal Project Manager to help deliver most important water programs under AMP8\.


In this role, Our Water Asset Design team works primarily in the municipal water sector as well as the non\-regulated (industrial / international) sector. Our clients include some of the largest water companies in the UK, and contractors working in the sector. We deliver wastewater treatment, water treatment, sewerage, and water network schemes, as well as supporting other related industries. Our projects range in scope from routine network maintenance projects to some of the largest water projects in the UK.


We are currently recruiting for a Principal Project Manager to join our Water PMO team to lead the delivery of projects involving multidisciplinary teams from optioneering through delivery and handover to the Client.


You will be responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring and control, and completion of a defined project or defined work packages within a range of major projects or programmes to meet the clients project objectives. This includes leading, guiding and developing multi\-disciplinary project teams, championing high quality delivery, and promoting a focus on health and safety.


  
**You will:**

* Manage project proposals including determining project requirements, scope, resources, programme, and cost estimates (budgets) for delivering the project
* Own the P\&L with associated commercial and financial accountability including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination and attainment, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing and cash collection
* Develop of project management documentation including project management plans, cost estimates and forecasts, risk registers, project schedules, stakeholder registers, project organisation charts etc. to successfully delivery the project objectives
* Monitor and control the project schedule, manhours, budgets, forecasts, and expenditure
* Ensure effective contract management including contract administration and change management
* Manage work being performed by project team members (including assistant PM’s working under your control), assuring outputs meet the project requirements
* Managing project deliverables, information, and records
* Effectively and accurately communicate relevant project information to the project team and customer
* Anticipate and take pre\-emptive action to address issues and potential conflict situations that may impact on project delivery
* Lead multi\-disciplinary project teams consisting of technical/professional staff and suppliers
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and captures lessons learned.

  
**What We’ll Love About You**

* You’re proactive, commercially aware and comfortable influencing at all levels. You can balance competing priorities, collaborate with technical experts and keep projects running smoothly, even across multiple offices and project streams.

**You will bring:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering and master degree in project management
* 12\+ years’ experience and proven project delivery on water infrastructure projects
* Background in engineering consulting with design management experience highly desirable
* Strong interpersonal skills, with experience working across distributed teams
* Ability to manage multiple tasks across several live projects
* Solid understanding of contracts, change management and drafting variations
* High competency in cost reporting, financial analysis, Excel and Word
* Experience setting up systems for project files, data control and compliance
* Proven ability managing project budgets and using financial tools
* Strong written communication skills, including preparing high‑quality reports
* Proven experience in the delivery of infrastructure projects (exposure within the regulated water industry and / or non\-regulated water projects would be highly advantageous but not essential)
* Working knowledge or accreditation in NEC supported with the necessary technical and practical skills to administer NEC Contracts
* Membership of professional institutions such as: Association for Project Management (APM), Project Management Institute (PMI) or Member of Institute of Civil Engineers (MICE) etc;
* Proficiency in use of project management tools and software;
* Demonstrate competence in stakeholder management, risk, planning/scheduling, and commercial management.

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Senior Engineer - HV cable
description:
As a Senior Engineer in HV cables, you will design, install, and maintain high voltage cable systems. You will lead projects, ensuring compliance with technical specifications and safety standards. Your role includes collaborating with teams, conducting site assessments, and providing technical expertise to ensure reliable and efficient HV cable networks. Senior Engineer will provide technical leadership for the successful delivery of multi discipline projects.


  
* Extensive experience in the design, manufacture and test of HV cables for use in HVAC and
* Desirable \- HVDC projects both onshore and offshore; including HV cable system design and ratings (CYMCAP)
* An understanding of IEC cable standards and CIGRE technical policies, its suite of technical specifications and supporting documentation, and the capability to fulfil a role as a cable expert.
* Preparation, review and validation of Technical Proposal from Transmission \& Distribution projects.
* Preparation of technical documents/calculations using Cable Modelling Software 'CYMCAP'.
* System designing experience \- Selection of Bonding System, Earth Continuity Cable \& Co\-Axial Cable, Short circuit calculations, Cable Bonding layout.
* Experience of witnessing 3rd party cable activities such as test, installation, transport etc. Attained or working towards Chartered Engineer status.

  
* Education \- Bachelors Degree in Engineering or equivalent technical discipline, preferably Electrical or Power engineering with five to ten years of experience.
* Cable design, CYMCAP, Bonding, Short Circuit calculation, Continuous current calculation, EHV cable design, Cable routing
* HV cable system design
* Cable sizing and insulation specifications
* Project management
* Installation, testing, and maintenance
* Compliance with standards and regulations
* Site surveys and assessments
* Quality control checks
* Team collaboration
* Technical problem\-solving
* Report preparation
* Health \& Safety compliance.

title: Assistant Principal Highways Engineer
description:
Location
Noida, India
Country
India
Contract type
Permanent
Work pattern
Full Time
Market
Transport
Discipline
Highways
Job ref
9311
Recruiter contact
Naveen Gill
Apply now
The role presents an excellent opportunity to progress your career and work within a successful team whilst at the same time growing the highways capability in the Noida/Bangalore office to support the multi region projects. You will be a proficient user of 12D and CIVIL 3D with some practical experience in AutoCAD and OpenRoads Designer software is a plus. Your role involves guiding team members and clients through approval processes, ensuring compliance with design standards, and resolving any issues that may arise. Utilising your communication skills, you will support and develop staff members through mentoring and guiding team members in their technical and continued professional development. Additionally, you’ll promote our health, safety and well\-being policies and ensure these are adhered to within the team as well as ensuring design outputs meet our quality obligations and requirements set out in our Business Management System (BMS).  

  



Your responsibilities will also include:
  

  

• Technical competence in detailed highways geometry design and able to independently deliver work and integrate with larger project team with minimal supervision from senior staff.
  

• Preparation of concept and detailed design of 2D and 3D Roundabouts, junctions, interchanges, generating earthwork quantities.
  

• A thorough understanding and/or experience with the 3D highway design software 12D is essential, and having hands\-on experience with CIVIL 3D and Open Roads is beneficial.
  

• AutoTurn, and Signs and Line design software would be a distinct advantage.
  

• Must have good understanding of working in ProjectWise.
  

• Interacting and coordinating with other teams on various multi\-disciplinary projects and contributing to project implementation of multidisciplinary schemes.
  

• Delivery to timescales, budget and technical quality.
  

• Handling task programme and budgets.
  

• Responding to client queries resulting from client reviews.
  

• Working within financial and program constraints.
  

• Preparing client presentations and supporting documentation
  

• Self\-learner, motivated and team player.
  

• Adhering to Mott Macdonald safety, ethical and standard procedures. Understanding and implementing Mott Macdonald Quality Assurance procedures.
  

• Competent to check the work of more junior team members.
  

• The role will include, Technical guidance, project management and work brief preparation to enable the team to produce detailed design for technical approval.
  

• Communicating with counterpart in lead office/Client.
  

• Shows flexibility in work tasks and locations.
  

• Willingness to skill transfer and share information and knowledge with team members; and work to a high technical standard.

  

  

  

You will also be able to demonstrate the following:
  

  

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering.
  

• Minimum 4\-12 years working experience in design of Highways /Motorways/ Freeways.
  

• Good written and spoken communication skills and be fluent in English.
  

• Be aware of current and emerging technical guidance for highways and drainage.
  

• An ability to provide hands on mentoring and training of staff to ensure quality of output and continuous technical improvement.
  

• To produce designs based on planning strategies and construction specifications for drainage and highways.
  

• Must have a significant knowledge of engineering design, design software, technical consents process, adoption and contract procedures for the provision of highways, drainage, and
   

utilities for new developments and regeneration projects.
  

• Ability to manage multiple assignments at one time.
  

• Proficiency in 12D design software.
  

• Experience in AutoCAD/AutoDesk and their suite of packages.
  

• Having expertise in Australian highway geometric design standards, specifically Austroads. Familiarity with other international design standards like DMRB, AASHTO, and Middle
   

Eastern design specifications/guidelines would be a distinct advantage.
  

• Experience / knowledge of various Design techniques in Highways projects.
  

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  

• Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills .
  

• Committed team player.
  

• Chartered or Incorporated Engineer with a relevant professional institution such as MIEAust or ICE or CIHT (or equivalent) or near chartered status with suitable relevant experience.
  

• Experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams.
  

• Good time management skills with the ability to prioritise your workload effectively; and Capability to work autonomously as well as collaborating within a team environment.  

  

  

  

Job Profile
  

  

Mott MacDonald’s Highways Division delivers services across the entire project lifecycle. Whether we are planning, designing and implementing new roads, or maintaining, managing, improving and operating existing highway networks, we deliver innovation, cost certainty and added value through collaborative working with clients and a culture of continuous improvement. Our Highways Design Services is primarily delivering projects to clients across various regions such as UK, Australia, Middle east. We specialise in design and construction, progressing schemes from option identification and appraisal through preliminary detail design to supervision of works on site. We also provide advice on procurement options and administer contracts from tender assessment through interim valuations to settlement of final accounts.


**Equality, diversity and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they have the opportunity to contribute.

  

**Agile working**


At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team and personal commitments. We embrace agility, flexibility and trust.

title: Senior Project Controller
description:
We are seeking to appoint a Project controls specialist to work within Advisory vertical and support our ME team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to the successful delivery of complex and high\-profile projects. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capability, and hands\-on experience in planning, controls, forecasting and digital reporting.


  
* Support project teams in fulfilling its contractual Project management obligations on projects during the execution phase
* Performs cost to complete analysis on projects and re\-forecast the adjustment within the systems. Evaluates costs requirements versus budget limitations.
* Develop, review and maintain integrated project schedules. Facilitate schedule workshops with project managers and discipline leads. Reviews performance trends, prepares analysis and monthly project performance reports.
* Develop and maintain invoice tracking system and support Project Managers with timely invoicing, documentation and follow\-ups.
* Supports project manager in sub\-consultant management throughout the project life cycle
* Produce accurate and timely project reports and develop automated project dashboards for project performance monitoring
* Prepares and assists in various levels of project reporting. Key contributor in the preparation of project reports following WSP way of working.
* Reviews performance trends, prepares analysis and cost impact and monthly project performance reports

  
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, construction management or related field
* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in Project Controls
* Proficiency with Primavera P6, MS Project, Power BI and advanced MS excel
* Experience working in multi\-disciplinary teams and managing complex portfolios
* Experience in process automation, dashboard development or digital transformation
* Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across time zones.

Preferred


* Experience working with international teams particularly across the Middle East region
* Possession of industry\-recognised project management certification(s) (e.g. PMP, APM or equivalent)

title: KSL1 System Planning Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Job Description**
-------------------


**System Planning Engineer**
----------------------------


**Location:** Bangalore
  

**Experience:** 5\+ Years


Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in helping leading energy and utilities organizations deliver reliable, efficient, and sustainable power systems through advanced planning and network analysis.


### **Your Role**

* 5\+ years of experience in Power System Planning, Network Studies, or Grid Analysis.
* Strong understanding of electrical power systems, transmission and distribution networks.
* Hands\-on experience performing load flow, contingency, fault level, and stability analysis.
* Experience in developing technical recommendations for system reinforcement and network expansion.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.

* PSS®E
* DIgSILENT PowerFactory

* Microsoft Excel
* GIS Tools
* Power System Studies
* Load Flow Analysis

* Stability Studies
* Network Planning \& Reinforcement

### **Good to Have**


* Experience with renewable energy integration studies.
* Knowledge of grid codes and utility planning standards.
* Experience working with international utility projects.
* Exposure to transmission expansion planning and asset investment optimization.

title: Performance Engineering Architect
description:

At Nespresso, our Digital \& Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.** **Position Snapshot:**  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

 **The Role:** *As a* ***Performance Engineering Architect****, you will be the senior technical authority for performance engineering within the Nespresso Quality Engineering organization. You will define and evolve the performance engineering strategy, standards, architecture, and reusable practices that enable Product, Engineering, DevOps, Platform, and QE teams to build performant, scalable, resilient, and observable solutions.**You will provide technical leadership to the Senior Performance Test Engineer and guide teams in adopting performance\-by\-design practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Working closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Platform, and Architecture teams, you will establish performance engineering methodologies, workload modelling approaches, observability expectations, and performance validation strategies aligned with business\-critical journeys and platform risks.*  

**In This Rol****e, You Will:**  

* Define and evolve performance engineering architecture, standards, methodologies, and reusable practices across Nespresso products and platforms.
* Establish performance validation approaches for load, stress, endurance, scalability, resilience, and performance regression scenarios.
* Support Product and Engineering teams in defining measurable non\-functional requirements, workload models, and performance objectives.
* Enable performance\-by\-design and shift\-left performance engineering practices across the delivery lifecycle.
* Define performance test architecture and drive integration of performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
* Establish observability and telemetry expectations, leveraging logs, traces, metrics, and APM insights to identify bottlenecks and support root cause analysis.
* Apply AI\-powered capabilities to improve performance analysis, anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, regression detection, and productivity.

* 10\+ years of experience in Performance Engineering, Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, or related technical domains.
* Proven experience defining and implementing performance engineering strategies, architectures, standards, and practices at scale.
* Strong experience with load, stress, endurance, scalability, resilience, and performance regression testing.
* Experience working with observability, telemetry, monitoring, diagnostics, and APM platforms such as Grafana, Dynatrace, or similar tools.
* Experience integrating performance validation into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.

* Strong analytical skills with experience in bottleneck identification, root cause analysis, and capacity planning.

* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted tools for performance analysis, anomaly detection, diagnostics, capacity forecasting, or engineering productivity.
* Experience working within cloud\-native, distributed systems, and microservices\-based architectures.
* Experience operating in federated or product\-led delivery and Quality Engineering models.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering techniques and responsible AI adoption practices within engineering organizations.
* Experience contributing to Communities of Practice, engineering standards, reusable assets, and organizational capability development.

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!

* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

title: SUPPLY CHAIN ANALYST III
description:
About TE
  

TE Connectivity is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. Our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, renewable energy, automated factories, data centers, medical technology and more. With more than 85,000 employees, including 8,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 counties, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS.

  

**Job Overview:**

  

  

The Supply Chain Analyst is a key contributor in executing and managing inventory replenishment across a global supply network, ensuring seamless flow from multiple TE manufacturing plants to regional Distribution Centers (DCs). This role is accountable for maintaining optimal inventory levels, driving supply reliability, and ensuring customer orders are consistently fulfilled in full and on time (IFOT).
  

Operating in a complex, cross\-regional environment, the analyst partners with Planning, Distribution Operations, Customer Care, and global stakeholders to monitor supply\-demand alignment, resolve critical exceptions, and mitigate operational risks. While primarily execution\-focused, the role requires proactive problem\-solving, data\-driven decision\-making, and process improvement, enabling continuous enhancements in inventory performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
  

The position demands strong analytical capability, advanced system proficiency, and effective cross\-functional collaboration, with exposure to global supply chain operations and opportunities to take on higher\-level responsibilities and leadership initiatives. This role provides a foundation for progression into senior or strategic supply chain roles within the organization.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**
-------------------------------


* Front\-Side Business Engagement \& Customer Focus

o Act as a key interface across Customer Care, Logistics, and Planning teams to ensure seamless order fulfillment and a consistent customer experience.
  

o Ensure customer orders are delivered in full and on time (IFOT) by actively monitoring order flows, identifying risks early, and executing corrective actions.
  

o Lead resolution of complex supply and order exceptions, minimizing disruption to customer commitments and ensuring proactive risk mitigation.
  

o Serve as an escalation point for critical supply issues, coordinating cross\-functional responses and influencing timely decision\-making.
* Operational Excellence \& Supply Coordination

o Own end\-to\-end replenishment strategy and execution for assigned plants and Distribution Centers across regions, ensuring optimal inventory positioning and service levels.
  

o Drive global supply coordination by partnering with plant planners, regional teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to balance supply, demand, and capacity constraints.
  

o Manage and optimize system utilization (e.g., SAP and planning tools), ensuring master data accuracy and effective MRP signal execution.
  

o Identify and implement process improvements in replenishment planning, inventory positioning, and exception handling to enhance efficiency and scalability.
* Performance Management \& Continuous Improvement

o Analyze supply chain performance trends and provide data\-driven insights to improve inventory health, service levels, and operational efficiency.
  

o Own and continuously improve key KPIs, including On Time Delivery (OTD), Past Due To Target Date (PDTD), Past Due to Request (PDR), Ship To Request (STR), Ship To Schedule (STS) and Inventory, driving accountability across stakeholders.
  

o Prepare and present performance insights and actionable recommendations to stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  

o Lead or contribute to cross\-regional and global initiatives such as process standardization, system enhancements, and supply chain optimization projects.
* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management

o Drive accountability and influence without authority across functions and regions to achieve supply chain objectives.
  

o Provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts or team members, supporting capability development and knowledge sharing.
  

o Lead and contribute to cross\-functional and global initiatives, delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, process optimization, and overall customer satisfaction.
**Mandate Skills:**
-------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA is a strong advantage.
* 5–8\+ years of progressive experience in supply chain operations, with demonstrated growth in scope, responsibility, and impact.
* Proven track record of operating in a global or multi\-regional environment, effectively collaborating with stakeholders across different time zones and cultures.
* Strong expertise in MRP, procurement, inventory management, and end\-to\-end supply planning processes, with the ability to optimize complex supply networks.
* Advanced proficiency in SAP (mandatory); experience with S/4HANA, SupplyOn, and IBP Response preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives or projects, driving measurable improvements in service levels, inventory performance, or operational efficiency.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into strategic insights and actionable decisions.
* Experience in managing ambiguity, resolving escalations, and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both operational teams and senior leadership.
* Proven mindset of continuous improvement, innovation, and ownership, with a focus on delivering business outcomes.
* Ability to mentor junior team members or lead small teams/projects, demonstrating early leadership capability.
* High level of adaptability, resilience, and agility in a fast\-paced, dynamic global environment.
* Willingness to work across time zones and travel as needed to support global operations.

  

**What TE Connectivity offers:**
  

We offer competitive rewards \& compensation. Our commitment to our employees includes offering benefit programs that are comprehensive, competitive and will meet the needs of our employees.

*You are a hands\-on cryptography and certificate services engineer supporting a next\-generation Identity and Access Management team. You will help design, administer, automate, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Hardware Security Module (HSM), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic services across Solventum’s global environment.*

*You are a self\-driven, hands\-on individual who enjoys solving complex PKI, HSM, certificate, TLS/SSL, code\-signing, and key management challenges. You bring strong technical depth, operational discipline, and a continuous improvement mindset to critical security services.*

As a PKI/HSM Crypto Sr. Security Engineer you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:  



* Designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise PKI solutions, including Microsoft ADCS and Keyfactor certificate lifecycle automation platforms.

* Managing external public certificate services through Sectigo, including certificate provisioning, domain validation, organization validation, and integrations with enterprise applications and services.

* Troubleshooting complex PKI, certificate, TLS/SSL, code\-signing, and cryptographic issues across enterprise applications, network devices, cloud services, and security platforms.

* Ensuring compliance with industry standards and security frameworks, including NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOX, ISO 27001, and CA/Browser Forum requirements where applicable.
* Performing PKI risk assessments, security reviews, disaster recovery testing, key ceremonies, and operational readiness activities for critical cryptographic infrastructure.
Collaborating with security, infrastructure, application, and cloud engineering teams to design secure cryptographic solutions and support enterprise security initiatives.  
* 

  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:  



* Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND 7 years of enterprise PKI, certificate management, HSM, cryptography, infrastructure security, or related experience
* In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:5\+ years of hands\-on experience administering enterprise PKI or certificate management environments, including certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, inventory, and lifecycle operations.
* Experience supporting Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS), Windows Server environments, and enterprise certificate templates or enrollment workflows.
* Experience with certificate lifecycle automation platforms such as Keyfactor, including certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal, workflow, and integration support.
* Experience administering HSM platforms or secure key management technologies, including key generation, backup, recovery, partition management, and operational controls.Strong understanding of X.509 certificates, CRL, OCSP, PKCS standards, TLS/SSL, code signing, encryption, and cryptographic key management concepts.
* Experience troubleshooting PKI, certificate chain, TLS/SSL, certificate deployment, code\-signing, and cryptographic issues across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
* Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation as an escalation point for high\-severity PKI, HSM, certificate, and cryptographic service issues.
* Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: 10\+ years of experience administering enterprise PKI and certificate management environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Keyfactor, Sectigo Certificate Manager, and Thales Luna HSM platforms
* Experience managing public certificate services, including certificate provisioning, domain validation, organization validation, and externally trusted certificate operations.
* Experience supporting certificate automation through APIs, scripting, ACME, SCEP, ServiceNow workflows, cloud platforms, DevOps pipelines, or enterprise application integrations.
* Experience performing PKI risk assessments, disaster recovery testing, key ceremonies, operational readiness reviews, and audit or compliance support.
Advanced scripting or automation skills, including PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or other automation frameworks.

title: High Speed Hardware Design Engineer
description:
**ARQUIMEA**, we are a **technology company** operating globally and providing innovate solutions and products in highly demanding sectors.


Our areas of activity are **Aerospace, Defense \& Security, Big Science, Biotechnology and Fintech.**


**In** **ARQUIMEA AEROSPACE DEFENCE \& SECURITY** develops safer and more reliable defense systems through technology, including **unmanned aerial systems (UAVs), sensing systems, command and control software, and aiming systems**.


We are looking for a **High Speed hardware Desing Engineer** to join our engineering team, working on the development of advanced electronic systems for aerospace, defence and other high\-reliability applications.


The successful candidate will be responsible for the design and development of complex high\-speed digital electronic boards, including systems based on high\-performance FPGAs and adaptive SoCs.

**MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Design complex high\-speed digital electronic boards from requirements definition through schematic design, PCB layout supervision, manufacturing and bring\-up.
* Design FPGA/SoC\-based architectures using devices such as AMD/Xilinx Versal, UltraScale\+ or equivalent high\-performance devices.
* Define and review high\-speed interfaces including DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, Ethernet, JESD204, SerDes and multi\-gigabit transceivers.
* Perform or support Signal Integrity (SI) and Power Integrity (PI) analysis, including impedance control, termination, crosstalk, power distribution networks and decoupling strategies.
* Define PCB stack\-ups, controlled\-impedance structures, differential pairs and high\-speed routing constraints.
* Design power architectures for high\-performance FPGA/SoC devices, including multi\-rail power supplies, sequencing and power monitoring.
* Select electronic components considering performance, availability, reliability and product requirements.
* Work closely with PCB layout engineers to ensure compliance with high\-speed design constraints and manufacturing requirements.
* Support board bring\-up, debugging, integration and functional verification using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and high\-speed measurement equipment.
* Prepare and maintain hardware design documentation, design analyses and verification documentation.
* Participate in technical and design reviews throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with FPGA, software, systems, mechanical, test and manufacturing teams.

**EDUCATION \& COMPETENCES**

* Level – Required education degree:


Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Minimum required experience;
* \+5 years of experience doing High Speed Hardware design
* Training/Specific knowledge required in;
* Solid experience in digital hardware and high\-speed PCB design.
* Experience designing boards around complex FPGAs, SoCs or processors with high\-speed interfaces.
* Strong knowledge of high\-speed PCB design principles, including transmission lines, impedance matching, differential signalling, return paths,crosstalk and termination.
* Experience with DDR memory interfaces and multi\-gigabit serial interfaces.
* Experience defining PCB stack\-ups and routing constraints for complex multilayer PCBs.
* Good understanding of power supply and power distribution design for high\-performance digital devices.
* Experience with professional PCB design tools such as Siemens Xpedition, Altium Designer, Cadence OrCAD/Allegro or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with board bring\-up, debugging and hardware verification.
* Ability to read and interpret FPGA/SoC datasheets, hardware design guides, reference designs and interface specifications.

* Training/Specific knowledge required in:
* Previous experience designing hardware based on AMD/Xilinx Versal or UltraScale\+ devices.
* Experience with high\-speed SerDes, including transceivers operating at multi\-gigabit data rates.
* Experience performing Signal Integrity and Power Integrity simulations using tools such as HyperLynx, Cadence Sigrity, Ansys SIwave or equivalent.
* Knowledge of EMC/EMI design techniques and design for environmental robustness.
* Experience with aerospace and defence electronics and high\-reliability product development.
* Familiarity with relevant aerospace and defence standards, such as ECSS, MIL\-STD, DO\-160 or equivalent.
* Experience with EEE component selection for high\-reliability applications.
* Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Test (DFT) and PCB/PCBA manufacturing processes
* Languages and other requirements


o Proficient in English (written and spoken). Spanish is a plus.


o Open\-minded and ready to be challenged in a fast\-paced, multidisciplinary and multinational environment.


o Willingness to travel occasionally to Spain for short business trips (project meetings, reviews, lab work, etc.).

  

The position is **located in** our Headquarters of **Bangalore (INDIA).**


We're looking for **curious, creative, tenacious** and **collaborative people**, eager to do things and unafraid to tackle challenges in order to contribute to improving the society in wich we live.


#### **Think Big, Do the Job \& Enjoy Life**

*At ARQUIMEA, we value diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other protected factors by law. All candidates will be considered equally based on their skills and experience*

title: R&D Principal Technologist, Product Development
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** R\&D Principal Technologist, Product Development

**Location:** Bangalore  

**Employment Type:** Regular, full\-time, hybrid work arrangement

 **The Job**

  

At AVEVA, we’re looking for an experienced **R\&D Principal Technologist** to join the **Predictive Analytics** product team. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building modern, scalable enterprise applications that work with **large\-scale industrial and time\-series datasets** and deliver rich, responsive user experiences.

  

The role requires strong **full\-stack development expertise with a primary focus on frontend engineering using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS**, along with solid experience in **C\#/.NET, REST APIs, and backend services**.

  

You will design and deliver complex product features across the full stack, contribute to frontend architecture and modernization, and work closely with Product Management, UX, QA, Architecture, and other R\&D teams. You will also help establish frontend engineering practices that improve performance, maintainability, usability, and developer productivity.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Design and develop modern, responsive, and maintainable web applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS.
* Lead the design and implementation of complex frontend features, reusable components, services, and common UI patterns.
* Contribute across the full stack, developing and integrating C\#/.NET APIs, services, and backend components as required.
* Design user experiences that remain responsive and performant when working with large datasets, complex visualizations, and data\-intensive workflows.
* Identify and resolve frontend performance bottlenecks, including rendering, memory usage, network utilization, data loading, and application responsiveness.
* Apply modern Angular architecture and development practices, including component design, state management, reactive programming, routing, forms, and asynchronous data handling.
* Collaborate closely with UX and Product Management to translate product and usability requirements into intuitive and consistent user experiences.
* Develop reusable UI components and frameworks that improve consistency, maintainability, and development efficiency across the product.
* Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services, ensuring efficient data transfer, error handling, security, and reliability.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, secure coding, accessibility, performance optimization, and clean coding practices.
* Contribute to product modernization, technical discovery, prototyping, and evaluation of new frontend technologies and frameworks.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to raising frontend and full\-stack engineering capability within the team.

  

  

**Essential Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of professional software development experience building enterprise web applications.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS/SCSS.
* Strong understanding of Angular architecture, component design, services, dependency injection, routing, reactive programming/RxJS, and modern frontend development patterns.
* Experience designing complex, reusable, and maintainable UI components and frontend frameworks.
* Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization, particularly for applications working with large datasets and data\-intensive user interfaces.
* Experience developing responsive, accessible, and cross\-browser enterprise applications.
* Good hands\-on experience with C\#/.NET, REST APIs, and backend service development, with the ability to contribute across the full technology stack.
* Strong understanding of API integration, asynchronous programming, error handling, authentication/authorization, and client\-server application architecture.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, design patterns, automated testing, Git, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience with frontend testing frameworks and approaches covering unit, component, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

  

**Desired Skills \& Experience**

  

* Experience building data\-intensive, analytics\-driven, or visualization\-heavy enterprise applications.
* Experience optimizing large\-data workflows across UI rendering, API calls, pagination, caching, lazy loading, virtualization, and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with modern UI component libraries, data grids, charting/visualization frameworks, and complex interactive controls.
* Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, reusable component libraries, and application modernization.
* Experience with web accessibility, responsive design, localization/internationalization, browser compatibility, and frontend security.
* Experience working with modern authentication and authorization patterns such as OIDC and JWT.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native application development, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Azure\-based environments.
* Understanding of backend and distributed\-system concepts including microservices, asynchronous messaging, caching, and resiliency.
* Strong production\-first mindset with experience troubleshooting UI, API, performance, and integration issues in enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and their responsible use for development, testing, documentation, and engineering productivity.
* Experience with industrial analytics, process data, historian platforms, time\-series data, or similar data\-intensive products is an advantage.
* Experience working with geographically distributed Agile/Scrum product development teams.

 **R\&D at AVEVA**

  

Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

  

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

  

You’ll also be joining an award\-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r\-and\-d\-careers/

 **India Benefits include:**


Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support


It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

 **Hybrid working**


We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

 **Hiring process**


Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process

 **About AVEVA**


AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

  

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

  

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

  

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.

title: Senior Manager, Global Connectivity, Cloud and Automation
description:
Location: Bangalore, Karnātaka, India
Category: Information Technology
Job ID: R61650
widget: Full time
Brand: PVH
Non\-Retail
  
**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

  



One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.


**About the Role:**


The Sr Manager of Connectivity, Cloud and Automation serves as the enterprise leader for security‑focused cloud networking, global connectivity platforms, and automation engineering. This role defines and drives the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operational excellence of next‑generation network security, cloud connectivity, DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms, automation frameworks, and reliability engineering practices.

  



**What You'll Do:**


**Strategic Leadership \& Architecture**


* Define and own the enterprise strategy for network security, cloud networking, connectivity platforms, and automation.
* Establish target‑state architectures across firewalls, cloud networking, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, observability, automation, and connectivity services.
* Align enterprise cloud, identity, and zero trust security standards.

  

**Security \& Cloud Networking**


* Check Point \& Cisco Firepower, F5 LTM/GTM/APM, NAC, AWS networking, Zero Trust integrations.
* Lead strategy and lifecycle of firewalls, IDS/IPS, URL filtering, and NAC.
* Oversee cloud networking for AWS and hybrid cloud environments.
* Drive Zero Trust integrations.

  

**Connectivity Platform \& Automation**


* DNS/DHCP/IPAM (Infoblox), Public DNS \& Domains, Akamai GTM/Geo, certificate management, automation (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Git), observability, reliability engineering, SRE practices, ITSM/ITIL stewardship.
* Own DNS, DHCP, IPAM, domain services, global traffic management.
* Lead automation strategy using Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Git.
* Implement observability and SRE frameworks.
* Manage digital certificate lifecycle.

  

**Vendor \& Platform Management**


* Lead strategic vendor partnerships and contract optimization.
* Ensure global platform resiliency and service delivery.

  

**Operational Excellence**


* Ensure network availability, performance, and scalability.
* Drive automation, AIOps, and reliability improvements.
* Lead governance representing Connectivity, Security, Automation services.

  

**Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders on Network technology strategy and design.
* Collaborate with global teams across Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, and Infrastructure \& Operations.
* Represent Network in global governance forums and architecture boards.
* Mentor engineers, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and accountability

  



**What You'll Bring:**


* 12\+ years in network security, cloud networking, or connectivity architecture, with 5\+ years leading teams
* Expertise in firewalls, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud networking (AWS), DNS/DHCP/IPAM, load balancing, NAC, and automation
* Experience leading global platform engineering and modernization
* Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills
* Experience with budget management and business case development / investment justification
* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Engineering or Computer Science required
* Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) preferred
* People management, coaching, and development experience required
* Strategic and analytical thinker with the ability to balance vision with execution
* Collaborative and inclusive leader who fosters global teamwork and shared accountability
* Continuous learner with curiosity about emerging technologies and their business impact
* Strong communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and simplify complex technical narratives
* Ownership mindset – accountable for technology / architecture integrity and driving measurable business outcomes

  

**Licenses and Certifications:**


* CCNA \- Cisco Certified Network Technician/Cisco Certified Network Architect Required
* AWS Certified Solution Architect/AWS Advanced Networking Required
* CCNP \- Cisco Certified Network Professional/Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Preferred
* CCDP \- Cisco Certified Design Professional Preferred
* CISSP Certified Information Systems Security Professional Preferred
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Preferred

  

**Physical Demands Category:** Corporate Office


* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

  



**Travel**


* Domestic: Minimal (1–10%) – Occasional travel, a few times a year.


* International: Minimal (1–10%) – Occasional travel, a few times a year.

  



**Communication Responsibilities:**


* Obtaining \& providing information to others


* Explaining policies or practices to others


* Influencing others


* Negotiating with others to come to agreement

Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.

**Digital Thread**

**Digital Thread** focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.

**Connected Twins**

**Connected Twins** build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. * Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.

title: Principal Consultant - Project Controls
description:
We are seeking a highly capable Individual to provide commercial leadership and delivery oversight for the UK\&I Transport \& Infrastructure PMO GCC team.


The role is responsible for managing commercial, contract, and cost management activities across a portfolio of projects, ensuring high\-quality, compliant, and data\-driven delivery aligned to UK standards.


This is a strategic, delivery\-oriented role requiring expertise in **commercial management, quantity surveying, contract administration, cost planning, change control, and PMO integration** , alongside strong leadership capability to develop teams, drive process improvements, and expand GCC workshare.


  
**1\. Commercial Leadership \& Team Management**

* Lead the GCC Commercial team supporting UK\&I T\&I projects.
* Drive resource planning, workload allocation, and delivery governance.
* Build and mentor a high\-performing team through structured development and coaching.
* Collaborate with PMO Leads, UK Commercial teams, and Project Managers.
* Support recruitment aligned with pipeline and strategic growth.

**2\. Contract Administration \& Commercial Management**

* Lead contract administration across projects in line with NEC/JCT (and FIDIC where applicable).
* Manage:



	+ Change control (pricing, tracking, forecasting)
	+ Compensation events, variations, and claims
	+ Contractual communications and notices
* Govern and maintain contract registers (EWN, CE, GC, etc.).
* Track contractual deadlines and ensure proactive compliance.
* Draft formal contractual correspondence and entitlement notifications.

**3\. Cost, Risk \& Commercial Performance**

* Support cost control and financial performance across project lifecycle.
* Manage commercial risks, opportunities, and entitlement claims.
* Support dispute resolution, withheld cost recovery, and claims management.
* Maintain and drive commercial risk registers and escalation processes.
* Contribute to financial forecasting, working capital recovery, and performance insights.

**4\. PMO Integration \& Delivery Coordination**

* Integrate commercial activities with project controls, planning, and PMO processes.
* Ensure alignment of **cost, schedule, and change impacts** .
* Coordinate reporting dashboards, commercial trackers, and registers.
* Support cross\-functional teams in resolving commercial and delivery challenges.

**5\. Governance, Quality \& Compliance**

* Establish QA/QC frameworks, checklists, and peer review mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with contractual, commercial, and internal governance standards.
* Standardise templates, SOPs, and delivery processes.
* Align with **RICS/ APM professional standards and best practices** .

**6\. Digital Reporting**

* Encourage **data\-driven reporting using advanced Excel (Power Query, Pivots)** and **Power BI dashboards** .
* Enhance visibility through automated dashboards and digital reporting solutions.

**8\. Business Improvement \& Capability Building**

* Drive continuous improvement in commercial processes and delivery models.
* Support bid development, mobilisation planning, and workshare growth.
* Develop structured training programmes covering: NEC/JCT contracts, Change \& risk management
* Mentor and build next\-generation commercial professionals.

**9\. Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as key commercial interface between GCC and UK stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with clients, PMs, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Support capability showcases and promote GCC value proposition.

  
**Experience \& Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Quantity Surveying / Civil Engineering** (Master’s preferred).
* **10\+ years of Contract Management / Commercial experience** , including **\~5 years UK project exposure** .
* Proven experience in **UK–India delivery models** and interfacing with UK stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of:
	+ **NEC, JCT contracts**
	+ Change order management
* Experience in:
	+ Change control, CVRs, forecasting, procurement, and contract management
	+ Leading multi\-project teams and delivery governance
* Strong commercial acumen and consultancy understanding.

**Tools \& Technology**

* **Advanced MS Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables)**
* **Power BI (dashboarding and reporting)**
* Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word)

**Desirable**

* Professional membership and Professional Qualification (e.g., **RICS, APM** )
* Experience in **Rail, Roads, Civils, Water or Infrastructure projects**
* Exposure to ERP systems and structured cost databases

title: Project Administrator
description:
We are looking for a full\-time Senior document controller. The role entails the storage and management of documentation in line with company procedures. Furthermore, ensuring that project documentation and client deliverables are transmitted and received in accordance with project procedures using varied EDMS programs. The successful candidate must have the ability to work independently and be highly motivated whilst having a good appreciation of a deadline driven environment. They should be detail\-oriented, dependable and trustworthy as they encounter complex and sensitive documents.


  
* Record issued documents in accordance with Project Life Cycle procedure.
* Receive and/or download drawings and documents from the EDMS and file in the appropriate directory.
* Provide the project manager with a schedule of documents received and transmitted including revisions.
* Filing electronic incoming documentation.
* Coordinate the issue and receipt of drawing information to the WSP offshore facility in India.
* Circulate received/downloaded documents to project team.
* Print A3 copies of all incoming drawings for distribution to the Project manager and Engineering disciplines.
* Keep a log of in\-coming and out\-going information.
* Upload drawings and documents onto EDMS in accordance with a schedule provided by the Project Manager (PM).
* Responsibility for high level review of project life cycle\-controlled documents.
* Setting up and maintaining document issue sheets throughout entire project.
* Checking standard details on outgoing documents and drawings, for inconsistencies, revision changes and format.
* Plotting drawings to scale for engineers review and issue.
* Scanning. Renaming, recording and filing incoming hard copies of drawings.

  
**Mandatory Skills/Qualifications**

* Ideally 8\+ year's experience of document and data management in a multi discipline detail design engineering environment.
* Experience of uploading/downloading from online collaborative websites is essential.
* The successful candidate needs to be conscientious, and methodical with excellent organisational skills.
* Excellent time management skills and capable of managing their own time/workload across multiple projects.
* Training will be given to familiarise them with WSP systems, the different EDM systems and enough knowledge of AutoCAD to manage and manipulate the files.

title: BIM Technician- Electrical
description:
To work as part of our Services Team to provide CAD/BIM support to engineering projects. The successful candidate’s role will be as a MEP Revit Modeller within the WSP in India in our Noida / Bengaluru office producing BIM models and detailed engineering designs and construction drawings. You can expect to be active on a number of projects at any given time. You will report to CAD/BIM Manager in Project functionally and reporting to Line manager operationally.


  
* Prepare the Electrical services modeling work
* Experienced in Containment, lighting, small power, fire alarm \& detection, Security \& access modeling
* Prepare MEP 3D Revit coordinated models
* Setting up BIM models to the project standards and liaising with Model Managers from client side.
* Implement best practices on process Improvement works.
* Adopt new technology and implementing in the team and process.
* Create work sets, work\-sharing methodologies in Revit Models.
* Flag resource concerns in advance to CAD/BIM manager.
* Project delivery responsibility on agreed schedules.
* Preparing plant room layouts, sections, details and coordinated services drawings.
* Agree priorities and deadlines for drawing/model production with CAD/BIM Manager.
* Input to the co\-ordination of engineering services on projects.
* Develop general arrangement drawings from engineers sketches and other design team member drawings and details and develop sketches into co\-ordinated building details
* Discuss and agree setting out and building services details with other members of the team
* Complete design sketches for information in tender documents for small / routine work
* Produce work to specified WSP in India CAD standards, suggest revisions to standards as appropriate
* Use templates for CAD/BIM work and use CAD/BIM library items to assist design work

* Follow QA, document control, archiving \& CDM guidelines on all work

* Ensuring all relevant standards and guides are used in accordance with WSP in India QA processes.

title: Network Operations Engineer II
description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast\-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

  

We are looking for a Network Operations Engineer (NOC) who is passionate about building large scale networks on the Internet. Reporting to the Manager of Network Engineering, the Network Operations Engineer will be part of a team that is designing, implementing and maintaining the DigitalOcean network from the Internet edge to the hypervisor connections. title: Advisor/Senior Advisor - Systems Architect - Lilly USA Commercial Tech
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

Lilly's Purpose
  
  

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our 35,000 employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

Lilly Bengaluru Technology Team is looking for a hands\-on Enterprise Architect and Technologist who can go deep technically — designing, prototyping, and helping build enterprise tech platforms for scale, speed, and innovation. This is not a slide\-deck architecture role: you'll be expected to get into the weeds of cloud infrastructure, AI/ML pipelines, data platforms, and application design, produce working Proofs\-of\-Value, and directly influence technical implementation decisions across the function.
  
  

What You Will Be Doing
  
  

Reporting to the Senior Director \- Customer Tech Innovation India, you will design and validate enterprise technology solutions hands\-on — researching emerging tools and frameworks, building Proofs\-of\-Concept/Value, and translating business use cases into concrete technical designs and implementation plans. The role has four technical pillars: architecting and prototyping solutions for key initiatives, providing deep technical oversight across the functional portfolio (code, infra, data models, integration patterns), owning technical relationships with engineering teams to drive delivery, and hands\-on evaluation of new tools, platforms, and industry\-leading technology.
  
This is a strategic and technically hands\-on position responsible for architecting, building, and validating the technical direction for the respective technology function. Working directly with engineering teams, you will drive the modernization and delivery of advanced technologies — cloud infrastructure, AI/ML models, data pipelines, advanced analytics, and automation/agentic workflows — including writing reference implementations, reviewing code and designs, and unblocking technical delivery, not just setting direction on paper.
  
Working alongside global CTI Architecture leaders, and the functional engineering and product leaders in Lilly Bengaluru, you will build and own technical roadmaps end\-to\-end — from architecture diagrams and design docs down to POCs, pilots, and production rollout — for advanced analytics, AI transformation, machine learning, productivity, and automation initiatives.
  
You will informally lead and work day\-to\-day alongside a small team of engineers and security specialists — pairing on designs, reviewing implementations, and staying close enough to the technical details to make credible build\-vs\-buy and architecture calls.
  
  

How You Will Succeed
  
  

Hands\-on / technical delivery
  
  

* Build and validate Proofs\-of\-Concept/Proof\-of\-Value yourself — prototyping architectures, integrations, and AI/automation workflows before handing off to engineering teams for production build\-out.
* Review code, designs, and technical specs at a hands\-on level (not just sign\-off) for high\-complexity or high\-risk projects, catching architectural issues early.
* Run the “Office of Architecture” for the assigned function, ensuring the team is working together to build and execute technologies of the future.
* Establish and facilitate the planning activities associated with architecture that includes strategic architecture (2\-5 year) roadmap development and management (for AI, Automation, Data \& Analytics, Application, and Technology), long\-range plan inputs, function specific reference architecture definition and management, and application / technology optimization.
* Facilitate, participate, and enhance both functional and central level architecture governance that includes project architecture consultation/technical leadership (particularly those that are highly complex, have a high degree of risk, or have multiple affiliate or global dependencies), project triage and as appropriate architecture reviews at a project/solution level from inception through execution, overall portfolio governance (including a functional portfolio view of dependencies, risks, and constraints), and functional level reference architecture governance (principles, reference models, standards, decision frameworks, patterns, implementation guides, etc.).
* Lead innovation activities across the function. This includes but not limited to: innovation, research, Proof\-of\-Value (POV).
* Make complex technical decisions in partnership with global Technology at Lilly and Enterprise Business Architecture team balancing business priorities and needs, enterprise business architecture principals and respective regulations.
* Implement a technology architecture roadmap and future strategy (Modernization of functional architecture – Platform, Information, and Application).


Governance, influence \& stakeholder management
  
  

* Lead large scale/highly technically complex / transformational programs across the function (Omni\-Channel engagement, AI transformation Technology Modernization, Advanced Analytics etc.)
* Actively promote good architectural principles and practices, looking for opportunities to go global where possible and maximize re\-use.
* Serve as the liaison to Global and enterprise Technology at Lilly Architecture, representing function from both Business and IT perspectives, ensuring appropriate consideration of the functional priorities are factored into the global architecture. This includes participating on the Global and Lilly Bengaluru \- Technology at Lilly Architecture Forum.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, including threats and exploits, and communicate relevant risk to business and security leaders.
* Ensure Enterprise Business and Functional Architecture principles and practices remain appropriate to evolving Lilly business / Technology at Lilly strategies and when differences arise, proactively influence changes as necessary. Where gaps exist, proactively seek to provide guidance and a solution.
* Establish a strong network of influence with Enterprise Business Architecture community and global Technology at Lilly architecture community, and with Information Security community.
* Establish good vendor relationships with key local and global strategic and innovative vendors in technology.
* Provide advice on technical aspects of system development and integration (including requests for changes, deviations from specifications, etc.) and ensures that relevant technical strategies, policies, standards, and practices are applied correctly.
* Ensure that business requirements are well mapped / incorporated into system design and the appropriate technology, skill and tool are chosen and aligned.
* Proactively identify and determine cases of Proof of Concept/Proof of Value and set the direction and approach to achieve.
* Influence the key capability leaders throughout the business and Technology at Lilly in the technical direction and customer experience strategies developed and stewarded through Technology at Lilly Global Shared Service organizations and global architecture.
* Maintain an architecture status scorecard (Governance, POC/POV, Modernization, and Alignment with principals), measure, and improve/upgrade the current technical/operational status. Share with stakeholders.
* Communicate the technology strategy with local and global leadership and ensure sponsorship and support for the direction.
* Informal supervisory responsibility to coach and guide a small team of technologists.
* Serves as a coach/mentor to those pursuing a technical career path.
* Capture and share best\-practices across all business units and geographies.
* Serve as the primary point of architectural communication for functional technical resources.


Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Information Technology or related field, 10\+ years’ hands\-on work experience including deep technical expertise across infrastructure, application engineering, cloud platforms, data, and AI/ML — not purely advisory or governance\-focused experience. Demonstrated ability to personally design, prototype, and validate architectures (POCs/POVs) rather than only reviewing others' designs. Comfortable working in code, cloud consoles, and technical design tools day\-to\-day, in addition to communicating with business stakeholders. Experience in a business affiliate (ideally from within Lilly). Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to translate technical detail into business\-appropriate communication and vice versa. Ability to work autonomously in ambiguous, fast\-moving technical environments. Proven track record of shipping complex technical programs — from architecture through implementation and production rollout, not just roadmap documents. Strong learning agility to rapidly pick up and hands\-on evaluate new tools, frameworks, and platforms. Ability to influence technical direction with engineering teams and leadership up to AVP (M4\) and IO (M5\) level, grounded in technical credibility. Experience with portfolio management and formal project management methodologies, agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.). High intellectual curiosity and a builder's mindset — genuinely hands\-on with technology, not just strategy. Solid understanding of privacy and security regulations as they apply to system design and implementation.
  
  

Technical Skills (Hands\-On)
  
  

* Cloud platforms: AWS / Azure / GCP — architecture, IaC, and hands\-on deployment experience.
* AI/ML \& Agentic systems: model integration, MCP/agent architectures, automation pipelines.
* Data \& analytics: data pipeline design, integration patterns, advanced analytics tooling.
* Application \& integration architecture: APIs, microservices, enterprise integration (e.g. MuleSoft or equivalent).
* Security \& governance tooling: threat modeling, secure architecture review, compliance\-aware design.
* DevOps/engineering practices: CI/CD, code review, infrastructure automation.


Other Details
  
  

* Position requires up to 10% Travel.
* Position located in Bengaluru, India working in a hybrid model.
