title: Senior Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
description:
### **Senior Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform**


* JR\-162794
* Hybrid
* Bengaluru
* Technology
* Full time

**Who are we?**


Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.  

  



A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.


Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
**Job Summary**


We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare\-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi\-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software\-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.


This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.


You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software\-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation\-first, GitOps\-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.


**Responsibilities**


OS Provisioning \& Bare\-Metal Infrastructure


* Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare\-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud\-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Build and maintain a repeatable, zero\-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per\-node intervention
* Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high\-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane \& Worker Nodes


* Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum\-based control\-plane fault tolerance and correct failure\-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones
* Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube\-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node
* Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end\-to\-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD \& Data Plane Deployment


* Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software\-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates
* Own data\-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network


* Operate on top of a multi\-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation
* Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS \& Kubernetes Upgrades


* Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change
* Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane


* Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non\-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast\-radius cascades from configuration changes
* Drive GitOps\-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift\-free

On\-Call \& Incident Management


* Own your shift of a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation, and lead incident response for control\-plane, data\-plane, and network events
* Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting
* Contribute to the shared incident\-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9\-12 Months


* Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per\-node steps
* Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion
* Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non\-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration
* OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks
* etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live
* Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane
* Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

**Qualifications**


Required


* OS \& bare metal: Deep hands\-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud\-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening
* Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement
* Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube\-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR\-IOV), multi\-cluster fleet management
* Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling
* CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline\-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet
* Networking: Hands\-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR\-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it
* Upgrades: Demonstrated zero\-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi\-node fleet
* Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage
* On\-call: Comfortable owning an on\-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response
* Automation mindset: Everything\-as\-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

Preferred


* Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK\-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance\-testing pipeline around one
* SR\-IOV NIC tuning and data\-plane performance validation
* SDN or private\-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
* Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

• **Power Delivery Expertise** : Deep understanding of system Power Delivery requirements and familiarity with Intel Core/Atom processor Power Delivery guidelines including IMVP specifications and PDN analysis


• **Circuit Design** : Extensive experience with Buck, Boost, and Multi\-phase Power Delivery Network design, including control loop understanding and very high current/low\-voltage power delivery design


• **Design Tools** : Proficiency in schematic capture using industry standard tools (Cadence OrCAD, Mentor Graphics xPedition, Altium Designer etc) and ability to review complex digital and analog circuits layout

We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

  



One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.

  

  

**Job Description**


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **SAP Landscape \& Platform Administration:** Lead administration, monitoring, maintenance, and technical governance of complex SAP landscapes including **S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, SAP CAR, SLT and associated SAP HANA systems** across production and non\-production environments.
* **RISE with SAP Operations:** Manage SAP systems hosted under **RISE with SAP**, coordinating closely with SAP Enterprise Cloud Services and internal teams for incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, infrastructure changes, upgrades, backups, restores, certificates, connectivity and operational issues.
* **S/4HANA \& HANA Technical Operations:** Own Basis activities for S/4HANA environments including system health monitoring, HANA administration, performance analysis, parameter management, transports, client administration, job management, kernel updates and technical troubleshooting.
* **BW/4HANA \& CAR Support:** Provide Basis and platform support for **BW/4HANA and SAP CAR** landscapes, including system performance, interfaces, batch processing, HANA resource utilization, availability, connectivity and integration dependencies.
* **SAP SLT Administration:** Manage and troubleshoot **SAP Landscape Transformation Replication Server (SLT)** configurations, RFC connectivity, replication health, latency, table replication issues and integrations between SAP source systems and HANA/BW platforms.
* **SAP BTP Administration \& Integration:** Support **SAP BTP** environments including subaccounts, entitlements, destinations, connectivity, Cloud Connector, certificates, trust configuration, identity integration and connectivity between BTP and on\-premise/RISE SAP applications.
* **System Upgrades, Patching \& Lifecycle Management:** Plan and execute SAP technical upgrades, SPS/FPS updates, kernel upgrades, HANA revisions, support\-pack activities and maintenance cycles while coordinating downtime, testing, validation and rollback strategies.
* **Transport \& Change Management:** Govern SAP transport processes across development, quality and production landscapes, ensuring proper approvals, segregation of duties, traceability and adherence to enterprise change\-management controls.
* **Performance \& Availability Management:** Proactively monitor SAP application and HANA database performance, identify bottlenecks, perform root\-cause analysis and drive optimization for memory, CPU, expensive SQL, background jobs, interfaces and application workloads.
* **Security, Compliance \& Audit Readiness:** Maintain strong SAP technical controls aligned with corporate security and compliance requirements, including **user administration controls, privileged access, password policies, RFC security, system parameters, audit logging, transport controls and segregation of duties**.
* **Audit \& Evidence Management:** Act as a key Basis SME for **internal audits, external audits, SOX/ITGC reviews and compliance assessments**, providing system\-generated evidence, control documentation, change records, access reviews, configuration details and remediation responses.
* **SOX / ITGC Control Execution:** Support and periodically validate controls covering **logical access, privileged access, change management, system operations, backup/restore, batch jobs, interface monitoring and production access**, ensuring identified gaps are remediated within agreed timelines.
* **Disaster Recovery \& Business Continuity:** Participate in DR strategy, system recovery planning and periodic DR exercises for critical SAP environments, validating backup integrity, recovery procedures, dependencies, RTO/RPO objectives and documenting test outcomes.
* **Incident \& Problem Management:** Lead resolution of high\-priority SAP technical incidents, perform detailed RCA, coordinate across SAP, infrastructure, network, security, application and vendor teams, and implement preventive corrective actions.
* **Technical Architecture \& Governance:** Provide technical recommendations for SAP landscape design, sizing, scalability, high availability, interfaces, cloud connectivity and lifecycle strategy while ensuring alignment with SAP best practices and enterprise architecture standards.
* **Vendor \& SAP Coordination:** Serve as the technical focal point for **SAP RISE/ECS, SAP Product Support and third\-party vendors**, managing escalations, service requests, problem investigations and implementation of SAP recommendations.
* **Automation \& Operational Excellence:** Identify opportunities to automate Basis operational activities such as monitoring, health checks, reporting, certificate tracking, job monitoring, audit evidence collection and repetitive administration tasks.
* **Documentation \& Knowledge Management:** Maintain technical architecture diagrams, SOPs, operational runbooks, DR documentation, system inventories, maintenance procedures, audit\-control documentation and troubleshooting knowledge bases.
* **Technical Leadership:** Mentor junior Basis administrators, establish operational standards, conduct technical reviews and provide senior\-level guidance during upgrades, migrations, outages, audits and major SAP transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications:**


* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP and SAAS services
* Extensive experience in Managing and working with Managed services
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS will be a plus
* Experience managing the implementation, enhancement, upgrade, and support of large ERP applications in a fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment
* Experience in leading through a transition to modern ERP platforms
* Strong troubleshooting skills, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and system optimization
* Strong understanding of automation, auditability, and availability in cloud environments and on\-premises solutions
* Communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and drive change across global teams
* Project Management skills are a plus

In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job\-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.*

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Role Description:
**About us**
------------


Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

**Business Overview**
---------------------


From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

**Role Description**
--------------------


As a SAP Workload Automation and Basis Engineer, you will establish and operate the scheduling and workload automation capability for our Financial Systems. Your primary focus will be SAP workloads, while the capability will also cover connected non\-SAP workloads across on\-premises, cloud and SAP RISE.

  

You will define how jobs and business processes are scheduled, coordinated, monitored and controlled. This includes designing reliable and well performing job chains, establishing safeguards for both the schedule and the systems, creating policies and operational documentation, and enabling AMS partners to execute workloads consistently within clear guardrails.

  

This is a foundational role. You will help build the capability around a new platform. You will create the technical and operational foundations that can scale over time, acquiring central relevance.

  

The role sits within the SAP Basis team. A strong SAP Basis foundation is required, enabling a vertical capability across the technical landscape, system performance, monitoring, business processes, SAP lifecycle roadmap. The role will engage on a daily basis with platform engineers, functional and application teams, aligning scheduling practices with business requirements.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Design and establish a robust scheduling and orchestration framework for SAP and connected non\-SAP workloads.
* Define standards for job design, dependencies, calendars, priorities, SLAs, retries, failure handling, reruns and recovery.
* Maintain an inventory of critical jobs, job chains and end\-to\-end financial processes, including ownership, dependencies and operational impact.
* Ensure that scheduling patterns are reliable, auditable, secure and maintainable across SAP, BTP, RISE and cloud AWS, os\-level, on\-prem, third party environments.
* Write and maintain scheduling policies, standards, SoPs, runbooks and operational documentation.
* Establish safeguards for high\-risk workloads, financial close activities, sensitive data flows, conflicting activities and emergency execution.
* Establish auditable quality gates and guardrails providing reliable, efficient, high performing scheduling.
* Define the operating model through which AMS partners execute scheduling and operational requests.
* Convert policies into practical runbooks, checklists, approval requirements and control points that AMS teams can follow consistently.
* Provide independent oversight of execution quality, adherence to policy, incident trends, SLA performance and recurring operational risks.
* Improve the model over time so that governance removes blockers and reduces manual risk without creating unnecessary queues or bureaucracy.
* Contribute to an observability framework that provides visibility into end\-to\-end financial processes, not only individual job outcomes.
* Define meaningful metrics, logs, events, dashboards and alerts for process timeliness, completeness, dependency health and business impact.
* Partner with platform, application and observability teams to connect scheduling signals with incident management and operational response.
* Contribute to incident management, problem management, post\-incident reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Investigate recurring failures and identify improvements to job design, dependencies, capacity, monitoring, documentation or operating procedures.
* Support change and release planning for scheduling components and critical process chains.
* Ensure appropriate controls for SOx, DORA, NIST\-aligned practices, internal security standards, segregation of duties and auditability.
* Work closely with SAP Basis engineers, application owners, Finance stakeholders, architects, security teams, platform teams and AMS partners.
* Explain technical scheduling and orchestration concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Share knowledge and help build a community of practice around scheduling, orchestration and process observability.
* Help shape the future organization, roles and responsibilities as the capability grows and may evolve into a dedicated team.

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* 5 to 8 years of experience in workload automation and Basis.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise job scheduling, batch processing or workload automation in a complex technology environment.
* Experience designing job chains with dependencies, calendars, priorities, SLAs, retries, failure handling and recovery procedures.
* Strong understanding of scheduling and orchestration principles across heterogeneous environments, including SAP and non\-SAP workloads.
* Experience creating operational policies, standards, SoPs, runbooks or similar documentation for technology operations.
* Practical experience working with operations teams, managed service providers or AMS partners through defined processes and controls.
* Strong awareness of observability concepts, including metrics, logs, events, dashboards and alerting.
* Ability to connect technical monitoring with end\-to\-end business or financial processes.
* SAP Basis technical experience, with a good understanding of SAP landscapes, HANA and S/4HANA.
* Goo conceptual knowledge of Linux, databases and networking.
* Scripting or automation experience, for example with Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of security topics, segregation of duties, auditability and change management in regulated environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience with one or more enterprise scheduling or orchestration platforms, such as SAP Central Process Scheduling, Redwood, Control\-M, Automic or equivalent products.
* Experience with SAP on HANA, S/4HANA, Central Finance, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP or SAP\-related integration technologies.
* Experience operating in hybrid or cloud environments and integrating scheduling with APIs, event\-driven services, data pipelines or cloud\-native workloads.
* Experience with process\-level monitoring, business process observability or proactive operations.
* Experience in FinTech, banking, travel, retail or another regulated, high\-volume enterprise environment.
* Experience contributing to technology product selection, proof\-of\-concept work or platform implementation.
* Familiarity with SOx, DORA, NIST or comparable regulatory and control frameworks.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

title: Senior FI Specialist
description:
Role Description:

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

  

We are seeking a seasoned **Senior FI Specialist** **(IC Role)** with 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) and enterprise architecture. Operating as a lead technical authority and individual contributor, you will drive the architectural blueprint, end\-to\-end solution design, and technical delivery of enterprise\-scale Record\-to\-Report (R2R) platforms.


This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA, high\-volume transactional integrations (specifically with BRIM), and modern enterprise financial platforms. You will serve as the primary bridge between Finance leadership, Product Managers, Technical Architects, and System Integrators (SIs), shaping the future of our financial tech stack, safeguarding North Star Architecture (NSA) principles, and ensuring zero\-defect accounting compliance across complex ERP transformation programs (including RISE with SAP).

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

#### **1\. Architectural Leadership \& Engineering Excellence**

* **Solution Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance (R2R) across all project phases (Explore, Realize, Deploy, Hypercare), ensuring strict alignment between core accounting principles, business requirements, and system scalability.
* **Core FICO Domain Expertise:** Drive design authority across core domains:


	+ General Ledger (GL): Universal Journal (ACDOCA), parallel ledgers, document splitting, multi\-currency frameworks, and financial close automation.
	+ Asset Accounting (AA): Asset lifecycle management, multi\-GAAP depreciation areas, and integration workflows.
	+ Subledger Accounting (AP/AR \& FICA): Business Partner and Contract Account master data, posting areas, main/sub configurations, payment processing, and open\-item clearing.
	+ Intercompany Accounting: Cross\-entity netting, intercompany settlement routing, and period\-end elimination matching.
	+ Managerial Accounting (CO): Cost/Profit Center accounting, internal orders, margin analysis, and managerial reporting.
* **ABAP \& Technical Oversight:** Conduct deep\-code reviews, debugging, and root\-cause analysis. Guide engineering teams on SAP programming best practices, performance tuning, and database optimization (ACDOCA/HANA views).
* **WRICEF Governance \& Clean Core:** Review and validate WRICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) objects. Drive strict "Clean Core" standardization vs. customization decisions to minimize technical debt and avoid unnecessary custom builds.
* **Design Governance \& Quality Control:** Review and sign off on Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Enterprise Structure Key Design Decisions (KDDs), and L3–L5 process maps. Ensure all designs meet strict audit readiness, SOX controls, and financial compliance standards.

#### **2\. Enterprise Integrations \& Ecosystem Orchestration**

* **BRIM Integration:** Drive deep integration designs between FI and SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) to ensure compliant order\-to\-cash, billing ingestion, and revenue accounting (IFRS 15\) flows.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Architect robust integration patterns connecting SAP with third\-party and ecosystem platforms, including BlackLine (Intercompany Hub, SOX Certifications, Multi\-Source Reconciliations), OneStream/FinDB, Snowflake data lakes, and custom middleware (MuleSoft API gateways).
* **Reconciliation Integrity:** Validate end\-to\-end data pipelines (Subledger \-\>GL \-\> Reporting platforms), ensuring complete financial reconciliation, zero data loss, and zero breaks in double\-entry accounting logic.

#### **3\. SAP Transformation \& RISE Implementation**

* **RISE Execution:** Serve as the lead technical authority on large\-scale programs such as RISE with SAP / S/4HANA transformation programs across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.
* **System Integrator (SI) Challenge:** Partner closely with System Integrators to validate, guide, and challenge proposed solutions, stopping rigid template\-driven approaches that do not fit the enterprise's long\-term architectural vision.
* **Migration \& Cutover:** Oversee financial data migration strategies, cutover plans, parallel\-run validations, and testing frameworks (SIT/UAT) from a technical finance standpoint.

#### **4\. Strategic Influence \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Cross\-Track Alignment:** Act as an individual contributor thought\-leader and bridge between Finance, Engineering, Product Management, and external partners, translating complex business requirements into elegant system behaviors.
* **Domain Mentorship:** Foster internal engineering/architectural capability by mentoring junior/mid\-level engineers and architects on SAP S/4HANA best practices, integration patterns, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI/automation in month\-end financial closing).

#### **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* **Financial Process Automation \& AI:** Evaluate, architect, and prototype emerging automation technologies, including AI/ML use cases for intelligent anomaly detection, Business Process Automation, Document AI, automated cash application, AI\-assisted month\-end close (MEC) forecasting, and robotic process automation (RPA), to reduce manual finance effort and improve reporting accuracy.
* **Architecture Evolution \& "Clean Core"**: Continually assess technical debt across our SAP and connected ecosystems. Proactively design refactoring plans to decouple legacy custom code, migrating toward SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services, standard APIs, and "Clean Core" extensibility patterns.
* **Benchmarking \& Tooling Optimization:** Research industry best practices and stay ahead of the curve on vendor roadmaps (SAP S/4HANA releases, RISE updates, BlackLine innovations, BRIM enhancements). Identify opportunities to replace expensive custom builds with native out\-of\-the\-box system capabilities.
* **Engineering Thought Leadership:** Act as a catalyst for continuous improvement within the engineering track by introducing automated testing frameworks for SAP, CI/CD pipeline enhancements for transport manager

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* **Experience:** 15\+ years of progressive experience in SAP Finance (FI/CO), with at least 7\+ years in solution architecture, lead engineering, or technical authority roles.
* **Role Focus:** Proven track record as a high\-impact Individual Contributor capable of driving architectural consensus without direct line management authority.
* **S/4HANA Expertise:** Successfully delivered 2 to 4 end\-to\-end S/4HANA greenfield/brownfield implementations or global rollouts, including international localization and multi\-gap tax/regulatory requirements.
* **Integration Track Record:** Hands\-on experience architecting FI integrations with SAP BRIM (Billing, Convergent Invoicing, FICA) and external subledgers/billing platforms.
* **Transformation Experience:** Direct architectural leadership in at least one full lifecycle RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Cloud deployment.
* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level capability in analyzing custom ABAP code, debugging standard/custom SAP flows, designing complex APIs/interfaces, and structuring custom data models.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep familiarity with financial closing and reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine (ICH, Matching, Close Management) or OneStream.
* Strong understanding of modern reporting layers (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BTP, BI/BW, Snowflake).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum product management methodologies in enterprise software tracks.
* Exposure to financial process automation, machine learning in cash application, or AI\-driven anomaly detection in financial close operations.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

**The Practice\- A Brief Sketch:**


Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept\-to\-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.


You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.

**Digital Thread**

**Digital Thread** focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.

* Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
* Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept\-to\-service process integration.
* Current\-state assessments and future\-state operating model design that improve end\-to\-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision\-making across the value chain.

**Connected Twins**

**Connected Twins** build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.

* Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.
* Simulation\-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
* Process architecture and future\-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision\-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Digital Thread and Connected Twin transformation programs from strategy through execution across product development, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions
* Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps and investment strategies for clients seeking to improve traceability, visibility, operational resilience and decision intelligence
* Shape Digital Thread strategies across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS and supply chain ecosystems to improve product lifecycle visibility and concept\-to\-service integration
* Define Connected Twin strategies and use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, logistics networks, facilities and end\-to\-end supply chains
* Lead executive workshops and client discussions focused on value realization, operating model transformation, AI readiness, simulation capabilities and supply chain resilience
* Drive process architecture, future\-state operating models and enterprise decision\-support frameworks enabled by Digital Thread, Connected Twins and GenAI
* Lead scenario simulation initiatives involving network optimization, disruption analysis, inventory strategies, manufacturing performance, quality improvement and supply chain risk assessment
* Define GenAI\-enabled decision intelligence capabilities, agentic workflows and AI copilots that support operational planning and business decision making
* Contribute to pre\-sales activities including opportunity qualification, client presentations, solution development, proposal creation and business case development
* Develop industry\-specific offerings, consulting methodologies, reusable assets, accelerators and thought leadership related to Digital Thread and Connected Twins
* Partner with Industry X, Data \& AI, Supply Chain, Engineering and Technology teams to develop integrated client solutions
* Build and mentor high\-performing consulting teams while supporting capability development, knowledge management and career growth

  

**Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role**

* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain and concept\-to\-service business processes
* Strong strategy and transformation consulting capabilities with experience leading complex client engagements
* Ability to connect Digital Thread, Connected Twins, GenAI and data\-driven decision making to measurable business outcomes

* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Strong storytelling capabilities and ability to communicate complex technology concepts in business terms

* Strong program management, governance and risk management skills
* Ability to manage multiple client workstreams while maintaining delivery quality and commercial performance
* Strong people leadership, coaching and team\-development capabilities

**Your experience counts!**

* MBA from a tier 1 institute with work experience in consulting or related fields preferred

* 
* Proven experience leading transformation programs involving Digital Thread, Digital Twins, Connected Twins, process intelligence, GenAI or enterprise\-wide business transformation initiatives
* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, supply chain planning, logistics, quality management and service operations
* Experience with Digital Thread ecosystems spanning PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS, product structures, connected BOMs, configuration management and engineering change processes
* Experience leading initiatives involving supply chain visibility, control towers, decision intelligence, simulation, scenario planning, network modelling or operational resilience
* Practical experience with GenAI, agentic workflows, AI copilots, prompt engineering and enterprise AI transformation initiatives

description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced RF Planning \& Optimization Engineer to support the design, analysis, and optimization of 4G LTE and 5G NR networks. The role involves RF planning activities such as coverage and capacity analysis, propagation modeling, link\-budget calculations, frequency planning, and interference troubleshooting using industry\-standard tools like ATOLL, Planet, and iBwave. The ideal candidate will work closely with product development, QA, and customer teams to analyze network scenarios, validate solutions, and drive performance improvements. Strong knowledge of wireless technologies, Massive MIMO, SON concepts, and radio network optimization is essential for success in this role.

* **Role: RF Planning \& Optimization Engineer**
* **Location: Pune, Bengaluru**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Perform RF planning, design, and optimization activities for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks to achieve targeted coverage, capacity, and quality objectives.
* Analyze and troubleshoot RF network performance issues, including coverage gaps, interference, mobility, and capacity constraints.
* Conduct link budget analysis, RF propagation modeling, coverage prediction, and capacity planning using industry\-standard planning tools.
* Develop and optimize PCI plans, frequency plans, carrier allocation, and neighbor relations to improve network performance and user experience.
* Support coverage and capacity scenario planning, traffic analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations for network expansion and optimization projects.
* Investigate customer\-reported issues, reproduce network scenarios, and validate software fixes within RF planning and optimization environments.
* Perform interference analysis and troubleshooting for LTE and 5G networks, ensuring optimal spectrum utilization.
* Execute handover parameter optimization, ANR validation, and mobility optimization activities to enhance network reliability and accessibility.
* Collaborate with Product Development, QA, Customer Support, and cross\-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues and improve planning workflows.
* Analyze and maintain site databases, frequency planning data, geographic information, and terrain datasets to ensure planning accuracy.
* Support SON\-based optimization initiatives, including Mobility Robustness Optimization (MRO), Mobility Load Balancing (MLB), and Radio Link Failure (RLF) optimization.
* Work with RF planning tools such as ATOLL, Planet, iBwave, or equivalent solutions to validate network designs and generate performance recommendations.
* Prepare technical reports, network performance analyses, and optimization recommendations for internal and customer stakeholders.
* Stay updated on emerging wireless technologies, including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, Beamforming, and cloud\-based telecom planning solutions

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Strong experience in RF Planning \& Optimization for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks, with a solid understanding of radio network design principles and optimization techniques.
* Hands\-on expertise in RF propagation modeling, coverage prediction, link\-budget analysis, and capacity planning.
* Knowledge of PCI planning, frequency planning, interference analysis, carrier planning, and mobility optimization for LTE and 5G networks.
* Understanding of Massive MIMO, Beamforming, coverage versus capacity optimization, and 5G NR planning parameters and KPIs.
* Experience with Automatic Frequency Planning (AFP), Neighbor Cell Planning, ANR, Handover Optimization, and SON\-based optimization workflows (MRO, MLB, RLF).
* Proficiency in RF planning and optimization tools such as ATOLL, Planet, iBwave, or equivalent wireless network planning solutions.
* Ability to analyze customer\-reported issues, reproduce network scenarios, validate software fixes, and provide effective technical resolutions.
* Experience managing site databases, frequency planning data, geographic information, and terrain datasets for accurate network planning.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret network performance metrics and KPIs.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across product, QA, customer support, and global engineering teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Exposure to 2G/3G planning concepts, telecom performance analytics, cloud\-based telecom planning platforms, and network automation frameworks is a plus.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Senior Consultant - Project Controls
description:
WSP India is seeking to onboard a dynamic and versatile Project Management Expert with comprehensive experience in Project Controls, Scheduling, and Cost Control to support our growing portfolio of complex infrastructure and engineering projects.


  
**Project Cost Control**

* Ensure alignment with client expectations and deadlines by coordinating with billing, finance, and project teams to manage accounts receivable, timesheets, expenses, and invoice\-related queries.
* Prepare billing drafts, compile and verify monthly invoices, and ensure accurate manual data entry and mapping to final invoice sheets.
* Manage project setup, budgeting, task assignments, and closeout activities in **Oracle Horizon** , including maintaining WBS structures, processing time transfers, and performing compliance checks.
* Support financial analysis and reporting by using financial systems to track project performance metrics, generate monthly accruals, and assess the impacts of scope changes and forecast deviations.
* Collaborate with design teams to collect engineering progress data for **Earned Value (EV) analysis** and maintain accurate tracking of planned value, actual cost, and schedule performance.
* Act as a liaison between GCC India and US teams for project setup, billing, and timesheet coding, while supporting the P\&B PMO team in portfolio monitoring.
* Conduct data integrity checks, audits, and maintain project documentation, including lessons\-learned databases and meeting records.
* Apply extensive ERP knowledge for project creation, maintenance, and change management.
* Create and track change orders, identify and quantify risks, and support mitigation efforts as a trusted partner to the Project Manager.

**Project Scheduling**

* Create, update, and maintain resource and cost\-loaded project schedules using **Microsoft Project (MSP)** or **Primavera P6** , based on stakeholder input, proposals, and scope documents.
* Develop activity lists, identify critical paths, and notify teams of key activities and schedule risks.
* Monitor project progress, detect deviations, and support recovery planning and schedule forecasting.
* Assess and report on the impacts of changes to baseline schedules and milestones, ensuring timely updates and resolution tracking.
* Support bids and proposals by preparing preliminary schedules and timelines.
* Use **Earned Value Management (EVM)** and financial systems to analyze and report on project performance and KPIs.
* Maintain accurate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and integrate project schedules under an **Enterprise Project Structure (EPS)** .

**Key Competencies / Skills:**

* Proficient in MS Office Suite, especially **Advanced Excel** ; experience with **Oracle ERP (Horizon/NetSuite)** and **Power BI** is an advantage.
* Skilled in project scheduling tools such as **Primavera P6** , **Microsoft Project (MSP)** , and **Smartsheet** .
* Strong understanding of **Earned Value Management (EVM)** and financial systems related to project control.
* Minimum of **4 years’ combined experience** in project scheduling, cost control, documentation, and procurement.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities; capable of handling multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
* Skilled in forecasting, reporting, and maintaining accurate project records and WBS structures.
* Strong coordination and problem\-solving skills; able to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and open to new challenges.
* Adopts a “Best for WSP” approach in daily activities.
* Flexible with work timings to support US\-based project teams across time zones.

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering with project management experience; a Master’s degree in Construction Management or Project Management is preferred.
* **5–9 years** of experience in project management with engineering or professional services consultants.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* **CAPM\-PMI** or **PMP** certification is an added advantage.

title: Associate - Pipeline Design (Water & Wastewater)
description:
Suitable candidate for this role is a Civil Design Engineer with proven experience in the design and delivery of buried pipeline infrastructure for water, wastewater and stormwater projects. The role requires a strong understanding of pipeline alignment development, hydraulic design and the detailed design of associated civil structures. The successful candidate will be proficient in Autodesk Civil 3D and capable of developing three\-dimensional pipe networks, long sections and coordinated designs that integrate hydraulic, utility, operational and construction requirements.


  
* The candidate should have experience designing horizontal and vertical pipeline alignments to satisfy hydraulic performance criteria while minimising utility conflicts and construction risks.
* They will be familiar with hydraulic principles relevant to gravity and pressure pipeline systems, including Manning's equation, Colebrook\-White analysis, hydraulic grade line development, shear stress assessment and self\-cleansing velocity requirements.
* A sound understanding of pipe material selection is required, including the relative advantages, limitations and application of PVC, PE, GRP, steel and concrete pipe systems.
* Experience in developing general arrangement drawings and detailed layouts for manholes, hydraulic control structures, valve chambers, maintenance access arrangements and other pipeline appurtenances.
* The candidate should be able to apply operational, maintenance, safety and constructability considerations when developing these designs.
* Knowledge of structural design requirements for buried pipelines is desirable, including familiarity with flexible pipe design principles in accordance with AS/NZS 2566 and rigid concrete pipe design in accordance with AS/NZS 3725\.
* Produce reports and presentations at high levels of professional and technical calibre suitable for presenting to clients.
* Apply sound engineering judgement and best practices to arrive at technical decisions that drive innovative, fit\-for\-purpose and value\-engineered solutions to meet project and client needs.
* Ensure that all technical risks are understood, managed, assigned to the organisation best placed to manage the risk, and that these are well communicated to the project team and/or the client.
* Ensure all assignments are completed on schedule and within budget while implementing Quality Assurance protocols.
* Support delivery of registrations of interest, pre\-qualifications, project proposals/bids, fee estimates, project work programmes and budgets.
* Work with project leadership to plan projects through proper scoping with appropriate inputs, outputs, verifications and project reviews.
* Help Technical leadership in developing, establishing and maintaining appropriate professional and technical standards within the organisation.
* Lead and review work carried out by junior colleagues including appropriate verification of projects and peer review work done by colleagues and team members as necessary.
* Maintain knowledge of appropriate technical standards, legislation, codes of practice and New Zealand norms to ensure compliance with applicable standards, specifications, tolerances, safety factors and project brief. Keep abreast of industry developments, trends and processes.
* Liaise and work closely with Sector leadership and peer groups across India and New Zealand; Act as a brand ambassador of GCC within WSP in India across geographies; Create opportunities to share learnings, improvements, new tools, better practices etc. with the wider water team; Develop and maintain effective networks and spheres of influence (internally and externally) with team members and key stakeholders.

Desired Skills


* Fluent in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate ideas and complex technical matters lucidly and with concise brevity.
* Natural and confident technical leader displaying openness, accountability, decisiveness and engagement; Client centric and passionate about service excellence who can recognise and manage commercial risks while demonstrating value to the client.
* Able to develop and promote technical innovations and out\-of\-the\-box ideas; Persuasive.
* Effective problem solver engaging sound problem solving techniques and appropriate analysis; Application of knowledge learning principles.
* Can positively impact and influence office culture with and optimistic and dynamic outlook towards opportunities; Can work collaboratively with different stakeholders and across cross\-cultural teams; Ability to communicate difficult/sensitive information tactfully.
* Display drive, energy and enthusiasm for getting things done with high levels of motivation and energy; Project credibility demonstrate professionalism and inspire confidence with high emotional intelligence and self\-awareness of strengths and potential areas for development
* Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail; Able to perform independently and/or under minimum supervision.
* Stay calm and deliver under pressure with ability to cope with urgency, work pressures and ensure achievement of project imperatives; Resilient, comfortable with change and ambiguity.

  
Software Proficiencies


* Highly proficient in Autodesk Civil 3D and capable of developing three\-dimensional pipe networks, long sections and coordinated designs that integrate hydraulic, utility, operational and construction requirements.
* Perform clash detection, coordination, and model integration within BIM environments, ensuring alignment across civil, structural, MEP disciplines.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications with strong skills in preparing high\-quality client presentations, internal reports, and business documentation.

Qualifications


* Master’s degree in civil engineering or environmental engineering or similar.
* Member of a professional body like CIWEM, ICE etc.; Chartered or equivalent status preferred.

Experience


* 15\+ years of experience as civil design engineer with proven experience in the design and delivery of buried pipeline infrastructure for water, wastewater and stormwater projects.
* Past experience in AU/NZ projects is preferred; should at least have experience in overseas (UK/US/ME) projects

title: Intermediate Professional, System and Application
description:

* Work with project teams and client stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify AI use cases, and define practical roadmaps, success measures, and delivery approaches.
* Oversee technical architecture and integration of AI and digital solutions with clients’ existing systems, data platforms, and security/governance requirements.
* Lead or support rapid prototyping of AI\-enabled use cases, including generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, knowledge search, analytics, natural language processing, and digital workflow improvement, and convert successful prototypes into scalable solutions.
* Help the Digital Advisory team adopt AI tools and improved ways of working, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, automation tools, and other approved enterprise AI platforms.
* Develop reusable assets for AI and digital delivery, such as prompt libraries, templates, playbooks, governance checklists, use case qualification frameworks, and proposal content.
* Collaborate with technical specialists and cross functional teams to translate complex engineering, infrastructure, environmental, asset management, and smart city requirements into workable digital and AI solutions.

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**

**Location\- Pune/Bangalore**

 **What you will do:**

  

As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands\-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.

  



Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.

  

The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.

 **How you will do it:**

* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud\-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo\-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown\-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo\-blocking and reduction of the internet\-facing attack surface.
 **What we look for:**

**Required**

* Deep, hands\-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on\-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi\-phase / multi\-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.
  

Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8\+ years of proven, hands\-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.
* Network security Professional level certification preferred (e.g. Zscaler ZDTA/ZCCP/ZCCA, Fortinet NSE, Imperva, etc.); Zscaler certification strongly preferred.
* CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.
  



Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers.

description:
### **Job Type:**


Permanent


### **Experience:**


8 \- 12 Years


### **Location:**


Bangalore


#### **Life at EvoluteIQ:**


We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry\-leading technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.


To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self\-driven and collaborative. People who not only want to be a part of a fast\-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and care—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.


**Could that be you?**


#### **The EIQ Mission:**


Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a **“dent in the universe”.** Our core fabric is Innovation! And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.


Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive every day at EvoluteIQ. To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge.


We make building of automation simple for everyone, so that it is not mystery for a few.


**Would you like to be part of this journey?**


We are looking for a strong, hands\-on **Java Technical Lead** who combines deep engineering capability with architecture, problem solving, design leadership, team guidance, and delivery ownership. The role is expected to understand and influence the complete application stack – from browser and network protocols through Java services, databases, messaging, infrastructure, security, scalability, deployment, and production operations. This is not a coordination\-only role. The Technical Lead must remain close to the code, be capable of diagnosing difficult technical issues, review critical implementations, make sound architecture decisions, and ensure that the team produces maintainable, scalable, secure, and production\-ready software.


##### **1\. End\-to\-End Architecture \& Solution Design**


* Own the technical design of major features, modules, integrations, and services from requirements through production deployment.
* Understand the complete request flow: browser/client \-\> DNS \-\> TCP/IP \-\> SSL/TLS \-\> HTTPS \-\> WAF/load balancer/reverse proxy \-\> application/API layer \-\> Java services \-\> cache/messaging \-\> databases \-\> infrastructure.
* Select appropriate architectural patterns and technologies based on functional requirements, system constraints, operability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Design stateless/stateful services, synchronous/asynchronous interactions, clustering, horizontal/vertical scaling, caching, distributed processing, failover, and resilience mechanisms.
* Identify architecture risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, integration concerns, and failure modes early in the lifecycle.
##### **2\. Hands\-on Java \& JVM Engineering**


* Provide hands\-on technical leadership in modern Java development and remain capable of implementing, debugging, profiling, and reviewing complex production code.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Java language fundamentals, collections, generics, exception handling, I/O, concurrency, synchronization, thread pools, executors, CompletableFuture, and asynchronous programming patterns.
* Understand JVM behaviour including heap/non\-heap memory, garbage collection, class loading, thread dumps, heap dumps, JVM tuning, profiling, memory leaks, CPU bottlenecks, and performance diagnostics.
* Apply clean code principles, SOLID concepts, design patterns, modularity, testability, defensive programming, and appropriate abstraction.
* Perform code reviews for correctness, performance, security, maintainability, concurrency safety, error handling, observability, and alignment with architecture.
##### **3\. Spring, APIs \& Middle\-Tier Engineering**


* Strong working experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot, including dependency injection, configuration, security, validation, persistence, transactions, and application lifecycle.
* Design RESTful APIs and service contracts with appropriate versioning, validation, error models, idempotency, pagination, timeout/retry behaviour, and backward compatibility.
* Understand microservices and modular monolith trade\-offs; design service boundaries, inter\-service communication, configuration, discovery, resilience, and dependency management appropriately.
* Experience with JPA/Hibernate or equivalent ORM technologies and awareness of ORM performance problems such as N\+1 queries, lazy loading, transaction scope, and inefficient object graphs.
* Understand web/application servers, connection/thread pools, reverse proxies, request handling, serialization, session management, and middle\-tier performance behaviour.
##### **4\. Database, Cache, Search \& Messaging**


* Strong RDBMS knowledge covering MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server or equivalent technologies.
* Design schemas and data models; understand indexing, query plans, SQL optimization, transactions, isolation levels, locking, deadlocks, connection pooling, replication, partitioning, high availability, and database scalability.
* Understand when relational, document, key\-value, search, or distributed data stores are appropriate.
* Working knowledge of technologies such as Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Cassandra or equivalents.
* Design asynchronous and event\-driven flows using Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ or equivalent messaging platforms; understand delivery semantics, ordering, retries, dead\-letter handling, consumer scaling, and idempotency.
##### **5\. Web, Network \& Security Fundamentals**


* Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, certificates, DNS, TCP/IP fundamentals, proxies, reverse proxies, load balancers, firewalls/WAFs, and secure service\-to\-service communication.
* Understand authentication and authorization patterns including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SSO, identity providers, RBAC, token/session lifecycle, and secrets handling.
* Apply API and application security fundamentals including input validation, secure headers, transport security, least privilege, secrets management, dependency hygiene, and common web vulnerability mitigation.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, database, network, certificate, proxy, load\-balancing, and infrastructure layers rather than viewing the Java application in isolation.
##### **6\. High\-Level \& Low\-Level Design**


* Own and prepare High\-Level Designs (HLDs) for significant product capabilities and customer\-facing solutions.
* Document architecture, components, responsibilities, integration points, deployment topology, data flows, interfaces, security considerations, technology choices, assumptions, and NFRs.
* Break HLDs into implementable components and guide engineers in preparing Low\-Level Designs (LLDs), class/component designs, sequence diagrams, API specifications, schemas, and detailed integration logic.
* Review and validate LLDs before implementation and verify that delivered code remains aligned to approved architecture and design.
* Maintain design decision records and technical documentation at a level that supports engineering, supportability, future enhancement, and knowledge transfer.
##### **7\. Non\-Functional Requirements \& Production Engineering**


* Take explicit ownership of performance, scalability, availability, reliability, resilience, security, maintainability, extensibility, observability, auditability, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and capacity considerations.
* Translate NFRs into measurable design and engineering requirements rather than treating them as late\-stage testing concerns.
* Define appropriate timeouts, retries, circuit\-breaking, resource limits, thread/connection pools, caching, queue sizing, health checks, graceful degradation, and failure\-handling behaviour.
* Work with QA/Performance/DevOps teams to validate NFRs through performance, load, resilience, failover, security, and operational readiness testing.
* Ensure production telemetry is sufficient for diagnosis through structured logging, metrics, traces, alerts, correlation IDs, dashboards, and actionable health indicators.
##### **8\. Problem Solving, Troubleshooting \& Root\-Cause Analysis**


* Demonstrate strong analytical problem solving and the ability to break down complex issues systematically.
* Diagnose performance degradation, memory problems, CPU spikes, deadlocks, thread starvation, slow database queries, network latency, connection exhaustion, message backlogs, and integration failures.
* Use logs, metrics, thread dumps, heap dumps, profilers, query plans, traces, operating\-system indicators, and infrastructure telemetry to isolate causes.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions rather than temporary workarounds.
* Lead the engineering response for difficult production incidents and customer\-critical technical problems when required.
##### **9\. WBS, Estimation \& Delivery Planning**


* Translate requirements and designs into clear technical work packages and implementation plans.
* Prepare and/or validate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), ensuring tasks are sufficiently decomposed for execution and tracking.
* Prepare and validate estimates for design, development, unit testing, integration, documentation, security, performance, deployment, and production\-readiness activities.
* Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks, unknowns, external interfaces, and critical technical sequencing before commitments are made.
* Work closely with Project Management to track technical progress, resolve blockers, highlight delivery risks early, and maintain realistic implementation plans.
##### **10\. Product Management \& Requirement Collaboration**


* Work closely with Product Management to understand business objectives, user journeys, product requirements, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
* Challenge ambiguous or incomplete requirements constructively and identify missing technical, data, integration, error\-handling, security, and NFR considerations.
* Provide feasibility assessments, technical options, trade\-offs, dependencies, and cost/complexity implications to support product decisions.
* Participate in backlog refinement and ensure that requirements are technically actionable before they enter development.
* Translate product intent into a solution that the engineering team can design, estimate, implement, test, and support.
##### **11\. Technical Leadership \& Team Development**


* Lead and mentor Java/backend engineers while setting a high bar for engineering quality and ownership.
* Guide developers in architecture, detailed design, coding, debugging, testing, performance, and production support practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and technical walkthroughs.
* Delegate detailed engineering ownership appropriately while remaining accountable for overall technical quality.
* Establish reusable patterns, coding standards, engineering guidelines, and review practices.
* Identify and manage technical debt, refactoring needs, obsolete dependencies, and structural weaknesses in the codebase.
* Improve the team’s capability to independently perform LLD, estimation, troubleshooting, and production\-quality engineering.
#### **What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:**


* Java 11/17/21 or comparable modern Java versions; strong core Java and JVM fundamentals.
* Spring Framework / Spring Boot; Spring Security and related ecosystem experience preferred.
* REST APIs, web services, microservices and distributed application architecture.
* JPA/Hibernate or equivalent persistence technologies.
* RDBMS and SQL; schema design, transaction management, query optimisation and performance tuning.
* NoSQL/cache/search technologies such as Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch or equivalent.
* Messaging/event technologies such as Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ or equivalent.
* HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, DNS, OAuth2/OIDC/JWT, API security and certificate fundamentals.
* Linux, NGINX/reverse proxies, load balancing and clustering concepts.
* Docker, Kubernetes fundamentals, CI/CD, cloud deployment concepts and observability tooling.
* Performance engineering, JVM troubleshooting, profiling, logging, metrics and distributed system diagnostics.
* HLD/LLD, architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, API contracts, data modelling, design patterns and technical documentation.
#### **What will you bring to the team?**


* Typically 8\-12\+ years of software engineering experience with substantial hands\-on Java/backend development.
* At least 2\-4\+ years in a Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, Senior Technical Architect or equivalent role with direct engineering ownership.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise\-grade or large\-scale web applications from design through production.
* Demonstrated experience leading developers through HLD/LLD, implementation, code review, testing, deployment and production support.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers, Project Managers, Architects, QA, DevOps/SRE, security teams and other engineering stakeholders.
#### **Must\-have:**


* The ideal candidate can move comfortably across the complete engineering lifecycle: Requirement \-\> Architecture \-\> HLD \-\> LLD \-\> WBS \-\> Estimation \-\> Hands\-on Development \-\> Code Review \-\> Testing \-\> Deployment \-\> Production Troubleshooting.
* Most importantly, this person should think beyond the Java codebase. They should understand how the full system behaves, be able to trace problems across layers, make sound engineering trade\-offs, and provide the technical leadership required to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, maintainable, and operable software.
#### **What We Offer:**


* Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next\-gen hyper\-automation platform.
* Work with a cross\-disciplinary team in a fast\-growing, innovation\-driven environment.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.
* A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
