title: Java Tech Lead
description:
**Company Description** *Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*

*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*

*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*

*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*

 **Job Description** **Module Lead – Java**

**Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**  

  

With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.  

  

The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.  

  

You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.  

  

This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns

**Experience**

* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies

**Tech Stack**

* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube

**Additional Information**

**Required Qualifications:**  

Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent  

  

**Personal Skills:**

* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.


Additional Information

**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**

* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* + 24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more

**The Location:**


Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.

**Start date: ASAP**


Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview

 **Qualifications**  

* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

description:
**Position : Cost Value Engineering** **Location:** Bangalore, India **A Snapshot of Your Day**  

You collaborate closely with Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and our global supplier base to create cost and value transparency for E\-House solutions — from modular electrical buildings to fully integrated turnkey units. You analyze technical concepts, break down material, fabrication, and integration cost drivers, and provide fact\-based design\-to\-value recommendations that support both product development and sourcing decisions. Your day includes building should\-cost models, validating supplier quotations, and participating in cross\-functional workshops to help optimize product architecture and specifications. With your technical and commercial understanding, you help Procurement prepare for supplier negotiations by delivering clear, data\-driven cost insights that strengthen competitiveness in the E\-House market. **How You’ll Make an Impact**  

Drive cost transparency for E\-Houses by developing should\-cost models and analyzing key cost drivers across materials, fabrication, and integration
Support design optimization and target costing by evaluating alternatives and identifying simplification and value\-improvement opportunities with Engineering
Strengthen supplier negotiations with reliable cost breakdowns, benchmarks, and fact\-based input for sourcing strategies
Improve competitiveness and profitability by identifying cost\-out levers in modularization, material selection, and manufacturing processes
Drive standardization of E\-House designs, BOM structures, and cost breakdown templates to improve comparability, reusability, and scalability across projects
Advance cross\-functional collaboration by representing CVE in the E\-House Commodity Circle and promoting a shared cost\-and\-value mindset across teams
Lead cross\-functional collaboration on creation of a price predictability model for E\-Houses
Contribute to the global CVE network by exchanging best practices, tools, and insights to continuously improve CVE methods within EAD **What You Bring**  

Minimum Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field (preferred: Mechanical Engineering).
5\+ years of relevant experience in cost engineering, procurement/manufacturing engineering, or technically driven supplier collaboration (or comparable engineering roles). Working knowledge of E\-Houses is a plus.
Strong analytical and cost\-engineering skills (should\-costing, value engineering, and evaluation of supplier data and quotations).
Clear, structured communication skills and the ability to collaborate across Product Management, Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Project Management, and suppliers.
Strong Excel skills and digital/tool proficiency; experience with TcPCM, aPriori, NX, or similar tools is a plus. Knowledge of advanced data management and multilinear performance pricing (MLPP) is an advantage.
Understanding of manufacturing and integration processes to assess feasibility, cost drivers, and supplier capabilities.
International mindset, willingness to travel, and fluency in English; experience working in multicultural environments.  

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most\-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state\-of\-the\-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.  

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens\-energy\-india.com

**The team**

* Experience implementing observability using Micrometer, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, AWS X\-Ray, Datadog, or Dynatrace

title: Senior Digital Verification Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:

MaxLinear is seeking a Senior Digital Verification Engineer to join our Analog Mixed‑Signal (AMS) group. The AMS team develops a diverse portfolio of integrated circuits spanning Interface products, including serial transceivers, bridges, isolators, USB‑to‑UART, USB‑to‑Ethernet, and PCIe‑to‑UART controllers, as well as Power Management solutions such as PMICs, point‑of‑load (PoL) converters, and power management controllers. These products enable robust, high‑reliability communication and efficient system power architectures across industrial control, networking, and broad multi‑market applications. In this role, you will:* Support development and execution of digital verification plans for AMS products, blocks, and subsystems
* Contribute to first‑silicon success through robust verification methodology, functional coverage, regression quality, and close collaboration with design, systems, and validation teams
* Create and maintain verification components such as scoreboards, agents, sequencers, monitors, checkers/assertions and coverage models
* Debug RTL and gate‑level simulations, analyze failures, and work with design engineers to verify fixes
* Support conversion of verification tests to test patterns and assist Test Engineers with ATE vector bring‑up


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with **4\+** years of related experience, or Master’s degree with **2\+** years of related experience
* Experience building block and subsystem verification environments using SystemVerilog, UVM, constrained random techniques, assertions, and functional coverage
* Hands‑on experience verifying digital blocks, clusters, or full‑chip ASIC designs, preferably including SOCs with embedded CPUs, serial interfaces, bus fabrics, or mixed‑signal interfaces
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Exposure to power management and/or serial interface systems such as USB controllers, USB‑UART, USB‑Ethernet, GPIO expanders, AXI bus, and embedded microcontroller‑based designs is a plus
* Passion for learning and engineering great solutions
* Proven written and verbal communication skills that demonstrate clarity of thought and conviction
* Good to have: exposure to Verilog\-A and/or Verilog\-AMS modeling for mixed\-signal verification and behavioral model development
* Working knowledge of one or more scripting languages (Perl, Python) and ability to use them to automate/accelerate verification and analysis tasks


Company Overview:

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ\-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system\-on\-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio\-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed\-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi\-market applications.  

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.  

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high\-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high\-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long\-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end\-to\-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.  

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.  

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside\-the\-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high\-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

description:
**Infrastructure \& Network Engineer**


**Noida, India \| Hybrid \| Full\-time**


A broad, hands\-on infrastructure engineering role with ownership across cloud, networks, security, datacenter operations, and local site technology.


**About the Role:**


Univers Bazefield develops performance monitoring software that helps renewable energy companies maximize the value of their assets and accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.


Our platform operates around the clock for customers across multiple continents. Behind the platform is a globally distributed IT team responsible for the infrastructure, security, networking, and operational services that keep both our products and our employees running.


We are looking for an Infrastructure \& Network Engineer to join our team in Bangalore. This is a broad, hands\-on role combining infrastructure engineering, networking, security, cloud operations, and local site support. You will help maintain and improve the technology that powers our business operations and customer\-facing services.


Because our team is intentionally lean, the role offers significant ownership and influence. You will work closely with colleagues across IT, product development, security, and delivery while acting as the local technical presence for our Bangalore office and datacenter facilities.


**Location and Working Arrangement:**


This is a hybrid role based in Noida. Much of the day\-to\-day work can be performed remotely; however, the position is not fully remote. Univers Bazefield maintains an office in Noida plus physical infrastructure and networking equipment in Bangaluru that occasionally requires hands\-on intervention.


Candidates should live within reasonable travelling distance of the office facilities and be able to attend on\-site when required, including occasionally outside normal business hours during incidents or maintenance activities. Travel to the datacenter will be required when determined by the business case.


**What Success Looks Like:**


* Become a trusted member of the global IT team and participate in operational support and incident management activities.


* Take ownership of regional infrastructure, networking equipment, and datacenter operations in the Asis Region.


* Contribute to improvements in reliability, monitoring, security, automation, and operational efficiency.


* Build strong working relationships with colleagues across infrastructure, development, delivery, and customer\-facing teams.


* Help strengthen the company's security, compliance, and operational maturity.


**Key Responsibilities:**


Infrastructure \& Cloud Operations:


* Operate, maintain, and improve the company's infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and on\-premises environments.


* Administer servers, virtualisation platforms, storage systems, backup solutions, and monitoring tools.


* Perform patching, lifecycle management, capacity planning, and platform maintenance.


* Support the hosting, deployment, and delivery of Bazefield services in collaboration with engineering and delivery teams.


Network \& Security Engineering:


* Operate and maintain network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, VPNs, routing, switching, wireless networks, and network segmentation.


* Assist with platform hardening, vulnerability remediation, access control management, and security improvements.


* Support logging, monitoring, security investigations, and incident response activities.


* Contribute to maintaining compliance with security and governance frameworks such as ISO 27001\.


Incident Management \& Operational Excellence:


* Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and post\-incident reviews.


* Identify recurring operational issues and implement sustainable improvements.


* Document configurations, procedures, standards, and operational processes.


* Proactively identify risks, technical debt, and opportunities for automation.


Datacenter \& Site Operations:


* Perform hands\-on infrastructure work, including hardware installation, replacement, cabling, asset management, and physical troubleshooting.


* Support regional datacenter operations and coordinate with vendors when required.


* Assist during maintenance activities, outages, and infrastructure upgrades.


Local IT Support:


* Act as the local extension of the global IT team for the Noida office.


* Provide hands\-on support for laptops, workstations, mobile devices, peripherals, and office technology.


* Manage end\-user equipment through its full lifecycle, including provisioning, maintenance, and retirement.


Essential Technical Experience:


**We are looking for strong practical experience across most of the following areas:**


* Windows Server and Linux administration


* Microsoft Azure cloud services


* Virtualisation platforms such as Hyper\-V and VMware


* Network infrastructure and troubleshooting


* Firewall administration and VPN technologies


* Identity and access management


* Microsoft 365 administration


* Server hardware, storage systems, RAID, and NAS technologies


* Backup, recovery, monitoring, and patch management


* Incident response and operational support


Networking Knowledge:


* VLANs, IPv4, and NAT


* IPsec, SSL/TLS, and VPN technologies


* 802\.1X authentication


* Routing, switching, wireless networking, and segmentation


**Relevant Technology Experience:**


* Sophos Firewall, or comparable platforms


* Active Directory, Group Policy, Exchange Online, and Microsoft 365


* Microsoft SQL Server, IIS and Reverse Proxy Technologies


* OpenVPN, Site to SIte VPN Infrastructure and Zero\-Trust Networks


**Nice to Have Experience:**


* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.


* Automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, or equivalent.


* Container platforms and Kubernetes.


* Managed cloud services, databases, or data lake technologies.


* Security technologies such as IDS/IPS, reverse proxy, DLP, and endpoint security.


* Observability and monitoring platforms.


* Experience working within ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar compliance frameworks.


* Experience using AI\-assisted operational tooling and automation.


**Education \& Experience:**


* 6\-10 years of experience in infrastructure, systems, network, or cloud engineering roles.


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.


**Personal Qualities:**


We are looking for someone who:


* Takes ownership and follows issues through to resolution.


* Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


* Is dependable, trustworthy, and committed to delivering high\-quality work.


* Can adapt to changing priorities in a dynamic and agile environment.


* Is naturally curious and motivated to continuously learn new technologies.


* Enjoys solving problems and finding practical, sustainable improvements.


**What We Offer:**


* The opportunity to help fight climate change by supporting technology that enables renewable energy production worldwide.


* A collaborative and supportive international team environment.


* Flexible hybrid working arrangements and a strong work\-life balance.


* Competitive salary and benefits.


* Short decision\-making paths and the opportunity to influence technology strategy and technical direction.


* Ongoing opportunities for professional development, certification, and training.


**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:**


Univers is an equal\-opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.


We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.


We are happy to make reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process. If you need any adjustments or support in order to apply or take part in an interview, please let us know and we will do our best to accommodate your needs.

title: Embedded Hardware Validation Engineer
description:
**Your Impact**
 You will be working on sophisticated, industrial, real\-time systems involving embedded hardware and software platforms, automated validation, and simulation of field conditions. This team of engineers develops innovative monitoring systems used for Grid Monitoring, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), and Generation applications in electrical substations and power plants.
   

  

**Here’s Where You’ll Demonstrate Your Proficiencies**
* Validation and verification of embedded systems incorporating ARM\-based processors, microcontrollers, Linux\-based platforms, and analog/digital I/O subsystems.
* Design, development, and execution of test plans for hardware components integrated with firmware and software.
* Development of automated test tools, test frameworks, and simulation environments for hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and system\-level testing.
* Execution of integration testing across hardware, firmware, networking, and application software layers.
* Support for regulatory and compliance testing activities, including CE, UL, IEC, IEEE, EMC, and environmental verification.
* Investigation and root\-cause analysis of complex system issues using electrical test equipment, protocol analysis tools, network monitoring tools, and system logs.
* Collaboration with hardware, firmware, software, and systems engineering teams to ensure robust product validation and long\-term reliability.
* Use of Agile Scrum methodologies to support validation activities, continuous improvement, and product quality initiatives.


**Qualifications**
 The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum four years of industry experience, including at least three years in embedded systems validation, hardware verification, or test automation within a laboratory or production environment.
* Strong understanding of embedded systems, digital and analogue electronics, and electrical engineering principles.
* Experience developing automated test solutions using scripting or programming languages such as Python, C\#, LabVIEW, or similar.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive high\-performance validation strategies.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, interpersonal, and technical communication skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with cabinet wiring, electrical safety, circuit protection, and industrial control systems.
* Hands\-on experience using oscilloscopes, digital multi\-meters (DMMs), signal generators, and other laboratory instrumentation for verification and validation activities.
* Experience with networking equipment, managed Ethernet switches, GPS, PTP, NTP, or other precision timing technologies.
* Experience troubleshooting network communications using packet capture and analysis tools such as Wireshark.
* Experience with industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, and related testing methodologies.
* Experience developing automated test harnesses, regression test systems, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test environments.
* Familiarity with protocol testing tools such as IEC Browser, IED Scout, Modbus Poll, and Modbus Slave.
* Exposure to fault location, digital fault recording (DFR), power quality (PQ), synchrophasor (PMU), condition monitoring, or other grid power system applications.
* Experience with Linux\-based embedded platforms and use of version control tools such as Git.
* Knowledge of serial communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, or RS\-485\.
* Exposure to cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessment, secure communications protocols, or IEC 62443 requirements would be advantageous.

title: Senior Consultant - Resource Geology
description:
WSP is seeking a Senior Consultant \- Resource Geology to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, delivering resource geology services to our global mining business. Reporting to the Mining Team Leader, the successful candidate will lead and deliver geological interpretation, three\-dimensional geological modelling, mineral resource estimation, and technical reporting for open\-pit and underground mining projects worldwide.


This is a senior technical role that combines hands\-on delivery with technical leadership. The Senior Consultant will take ownership of assigned resource geology scopes, provide guidance and review for junior geologists, engage directly with WSP global mining leaders and clients, and ensure that geological models and mineral resource estimates are technically defensible, well documented, and consistent with recognised reporting standards such as JORC, NI 43\-101, and S\-K 1300\.


  
**Geological Data Management and Validation**  

* Lead the compilation, validation, and management of exploration and resource datasets, including collar, survey, lithology, alteration, mineralisation, density, geotechnical, and assay information.
* Review sampling, QA/QC, and laboratory data, assess data quality and fitness for use in mineral resource estimation, and document findings and corrective actions.
* Oversee database preparation, data import, coding, compositing, and reconciliation activities in accordance with project and WSP procedures.
* Maintain rigorous data lineage, assumptions registers, and version control for geological models and estimation inputs.

**Geological Interpretation and 3D Modelling**  

* Lead the interpretation of orebody geometry, lithology, stratigraphy, weathering, alteration, mineralisation, and structural controls using drilling, mapping, geophysical, and other datasets.
* Develop, update, and review three\-dimensional geological, domain, and mineralisation models for open\-pit and underground deposits.
* Produce and review geological sections, plans, wireframes, surfaces, solids, and supporting visualisations for technical review and client communication.
* Work with geotechnical, hydrogeological, mine planning, and engineering disciplines to ensure geological interpretations support wider project objectives.
**Mineral Resource Estimation**  

* Lead exploratory data analysis, domaining, compositing, top\-cut assessment, declustering, variography, density assignment, and selection of estimation parameters.
* Build, review, and validate block models using appropriate estimation techniques, and support Competent or Qualified Persons in resource sign\-off.
* Undertake model validation using visual, statistical, and spatial comparison methods, and clearly document results and limitations.
* Lead mineral resource classification, reporting, reconciliation, risk, and sensitivity assessments in line with applicable project and reporting requirements.

**Technical Reporting and Compliance**  

* Author and review technical reports, memoranda, presentations, model documentation, data\-room reviews, and due\-diligence deliverables.
* Deliver work aligned with recognised mineral resource reporting frameworks, including JORC, NI 43\-101, and S\-K 1300, as applicable to the assignment.
* Prepare clear descriptions of data, methods, assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations for internal, client, and public\-reporting audiences.
* Ensure calculations, figures, tables, and model outputs are technically consistent, traceable, and suitable for independent review or audit.
* Apply and uphold WSP quality\-management, checking, review, document\-control, health, safety, and environmental requirements.
**Exploration and Field Support**  

* Plan, review, and provide technical oversight of exploration, drilling, logging, sampling, QA/QC, density, mapping, and field data\-collection programmes.
* Undertake or supervise geological core logging, field mapping, sampling oversight, and contractor coordination during site assignments.
* Assess the adequacy and spatial distribution of geological information and recommend additional data collection where required.
* Comply with project and site health, safety, environmental, and operational requirements during all field activities.
**Project Delivery, Leadership, and Collaboration**  

* Deliver assigned resource geology scopes across WSP's global mining business as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team.
* Work closely with the Mining Team Leader on resourcing, planning, scheduling, budgets, quality expectations, and delivery of project commitments.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and review for junior and intermediate geologists, and support their technical development.
* Engage directly with WSP global mining leaders, project managers, and clients to clarify requirements, present findings, and provide expert recommendations.
* Participate in the full project lifecycle, including proposals, scopes of work, contract inputs, technical quality, and senior review.
* Communicate progress, data limitations, technical risks, and required decisions promptly and clearly across regions and time zones.
* Support business development through technical input into proposals, client meetings, and presentations.
* Contribute to standard methods, templates, reusable workflows, lessons learned, knowledge sharing, and capability building within the team.

  
**Education and Experience**  

* Master's degree in Geology, Applied Geology, Engineering Geology, Mining Geology, Earth Sciences, or a related discipline. A Bachelor's degree with strong relevant experience will also be considered.
* Approximately 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in resource geology, exploration geology, or mining consulting, covering open\-pit and/or underground projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering geological models and mineral resource estimates as part of studies, operations, or independent reviews.

**Technical Skills**  

* Strong capability in geological interpretation, three\-dimensional wireframing, domaining, block modelling, and resource model validation.
* Sound understanding of sampling theory, QA/QC, descriptive statistics, geostatistics, variography, and common estimation methods.
* Working knowledge of mineral resource reporting frameworks, including JORC, NI 43\-101, and S\-K 1300\.
* Proficiency in relevant geological and mining software such as Leapfrog Geo / Edge, Datamine, Surpac, Vulcan, Micromine, Maptek, Deswik, AutoCAD, ArcGIS, or QGIS.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with large, complex technical datasets.
* Ability to prepare and review clear figures, plans, sections, tables, model documentation, and technical reports in English.
* Understanding of quality assurance, technical checking, data governance, and version control for geological deliverables.

**Mining and Consulting Knowledge**  

* Solid understanding of open\-pit and underground mining workflows and how geological models inform mine planning, evaluation, and investment decisions.
* Ability to identify geological uncertainties and clearly communicate their implications for resource confidence and project outcomes.
* Awareness of multidisciplinary interfaces with geotechnical engineering, hydrogeology, metallurgy, mine planning, environment, and closure.
* Proven ability to deliver technically appropriate, cost\-effective solutions within scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety requirements.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English; proficiency in French is considered an advantage, although not mandatory.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience leading mineral resource estimates for open\-pit or underground hard\-rock mining projects.
* Exposure to multiple commodities, deposit styles, and stages of study or operation.
* Experience with database systems, scripting, workflow automation, Python, R, SQL, or data visualisation tools.
* Experience contributing to technical studies, due diligence, audits, independent reviews, or public\-reporting documentation.
* Field experience in geological mapping, drilling supervision, core logging, sampling, or exploration

**programme management.*** Familiarity with reconciliation, grade control, short\-term modelling, or operational geology workflows.
* Experience working within distributed, multidisciplinary, or global project teams.
* Professional registration, or eligibility for registration, with a recognised professional geoscience body, with progress toward Competent or Qualified Person status considered an advantage.

**Key Competencies**  

Geological judgement Develops and defends sound interpretations from available evidence and clearly communicates uncertainty and limitations.
  

Technical leadership Takes ownership of assigned scopes, guides junior staff, and provides constructive technical review.
  

Technical accuracy Applies rigorous checking, consistent methods, and strong attention to detail across datasets, models, and reports.
  

Problem solving Investigates data and modelling issues systematically and develops practical, defensible solutions.
  

Client focus Understands client and project needs and delivers responsive, value\-adding technical advice.
  

Communication Presents technical findings clearly through concise writing, effective graphics, and confident discussion.
  

Delivery focus Plans work, meets commitments, raises risks early, and supports safe, high\-quality project outcomes.
  

Continuous learning Builds capability in geological methods, software, reporting standards, and emerging industry practice.

title: Senior Port Infrastructure Engineer
description:
* Permanent Contract


* Mid\-Senior Level


* Bengaluru


* Technical Engineering

  
About Us  

  

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.


With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

  

  

About the Role  

  

**Senior Port Infrastructure Engineer**


**Position Summary**


The **Senior Port Infrastructure Engineer** will be responsible for the planning, design, technical coordination, and delivery of port, marine, and associated landside infrastructure projects. The role requires strong civil and maritime engineering expertise, with particular emphasis on **port infrastructure, marine structures, terminal facilities, pavement and utility systems, and multidisciplinary design coordination**.


The position will support projects from feasibility and concept development through detailed design, tender documentation, construction support, and commissioning. The engineer will work closely with clients, port operators, contractors, specialist consultants, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Port \& Marine Infrastructure Design**


* Lead and undertake engineering design for port and marine infrastructure, including:
	+ Quay walls and berthing structures
	+ Jetties, piers, dolphins, and access trestles
	+ Ro\-Ro ramps and ferry facilities
	+ Breakwaters and coastal protection works
	+ Revetments and shoreline structures
	+ Dredging and reclamation works
	+ Port basins, navigation channels, and turning circles
	+ Container, bulk, general cargo, and multipurpose terminal infrastructure
* Develop engineering solutions considering vessel characteristics, operational requirements, geotechnical conditions, marine environment, constructability, durability, and whole\-life performance.
* Review and coordinate structural, geotechnical, coastal, pavement, drainage, utilities, and marine systems designs.

**Landside Port Infrastructure**


* Develop and review designs for:
	+ Heavy\-duty port pavements and container yards
	+ Internal port roads and access infrastructure
	+ Terminal drainage systems
	+ Utility corridors and service networks
	+ Rail interfaces where applicable
	+ Terminal buildings and ancillary infrastructure interfaces
	+ Gates, security infrastructure, fencing, and operational areas
* Coordinate infrastructure layouts with terminal planning and cargo\-handling equipment requirements, including STS cranes, RTGs/RMGs, mobile harbour cranes, reach stackers, conveyors, and other terminal equipment.

**Engineering Analysis \& Technical Documentation**


* Prepare and review:
	+ Feasibility and technical studies
	+ Basis of Design and design criteria
	+ Concept, preliminary, and detailed engineering designs
	+ Engineering calculations
	+ Technical specifications
	+ Design drawings
	+ Bills of quantities and cost estimates
	+ Tender documentation
	+ Technical reports and design submissions
* Undertake technical evaluations and option studies to identify appropriate engineering solutions.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant international and local standards, codes, client requirements, and good maritime engineering practice.

**Tender \& Procurement Support**


* Support preparation of **EPC, Design\-Build, and traditional design\-bid\-build tender packages**.
* Prepare scopes of work, technical specifications, drawings, schedules, and employer's requirements.
* Review contractor and consultant technical proposals.
* Participate in technical bid evaluations, clarifications, and tender negotiations.
* Review contractor design proposals, methodologies, value\-engineering proposals, and alternative technical solutions.

**Construction \& Site Support**


* Provide engineering support during construction.
* Review:
	+ Contractor design submissions
	+ Shop drawings
	+ Method statements
	+ Material submissions
	+ RFIs and technical queries
	+ Temporary works proposals
* Participate in site inspections and technical meetings as required.
* Assist in resolving design and construction interface issues.
* Review design changes and assess their technical, cost, programme, and operational implications.
* Support testing, commissioning, handover, and close\-out activities.

**Multidisciplinary Coordination**


* Coordinate with:
	+ Structural engineers
	+ Geotechnical engineers
	+ Coastal and hydraulic engineers
	+ Dredging and reclamation specialists
	+ Terminal planners
	+ Roads and pavement engineers
	+ Drainage and utilities engineers
	+ Electrical and mechanical engineers
	+ Environmental specialists
	+ BIM/CAD teams
	+ Quantity surveyors and cost consultants
* Manage technical interfaces between marine structures, landside infrastructure, terminal operations, and cargo\-handling systems.
* Participate in design reviews, workshops, HAZID/risk reviews, constructability reviews, and value\-engineering exercises.

**Technical Leadership**


* Provide technical guidance to engineers, designers, and CAD/BIM personnel.
* Review engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, and reports prepared by junior engineers.
* Ensure appropriate QA/QC procedures are implemented.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation measures.
* Promote technically robust, safe, constructible, sustainable, and cost\-effective engineering solutions.
* Contribute to development and implementation of engineering standards and best practices within the port and maritime team.

  

  

What do we need from you  

  

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in **Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering**, or a closely related discipline.
* Master's degree in Civil, Structural, Maritime, Coastal, Geotechnical, or Port Engineering is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, or equivalent professional registration is preferred.

**Experience**


* Typically **10–15\+ years of relevant civil/infrastructure engineering experience**, with substantial experience in **ports, maritime infrastructure, marine structures, or major heavy civil infrastructure**.
* Demonstrable experience in the design and/or delivery of major port and marine projects.
* Experience through multiple project stages, preferably including feasibility, concept design, detailed design, tendering, and construction.
* Middle East/GCC port infrastructure experience is advantageous.
* Experience working for an engineering consultant, port authority, developer, or major marine contractor is desirable.

**Technical Knowledge**


Strong knowledge of several of the following areas is expected:


* Quay wall and marine structure design
* Berthing and mooring infrastructure
* Dredging and reclamation
* Breakwaters and coastal protection
* Port pavement and heavy\-duty yard design
* Geotechnical considerations for marine structures
* Marine durability and corrosion protection
* Fender and mooring systems
* Port drainage and utilities
* Terminal infrastructure planning
* Construction methodologies for marine works
* Design risk management and constructability
* International maritime and civil engineering standards

Familiarity with relevant guidance and standards such as **PIANC, BS/Eurocodes, ACI, AASHTO, CIRIA, ROM, OCIMF** and applicable local authority requirements is desirable.

### **2\. Automation \& Agentic AI**


* **Automation and orchestration:** Design and implement robust automation workflows using Python, TypeScript, APIs, serverless services, CI/CD pipelines, event\-driven design, infrastructure automation, and cloud\-native orchestration patterns.
* **Agentic AI and AgentOps:** Lead the development and operational governance of AI agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool calling, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, agent monitoring, evaluation, safety guardrails, access controls, incident response, and production support processes.

### **3\. AI Platform Evaluation \& Assessment**


* **AI platform evaluation and adoption:** Evaluate enterprise AI platforms and productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Dataiku, coding assistants, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, Codex, and other emerging AI tools as good\-to\-have capabilities, validating their architecture fit, governance readiness, security posture, integration model, and business value.

### **3\. Governance, Security \& Performance**


* **Cloud security and governance:** Define and enforce security controls across GCP, including IAM, least privilege access, network security, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, policy controls, data protection, and responsible AI governance standards.
* **Production reliability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, tracing, incident response, performance tuning, release readiness, operational runbooks, and support practices for AI, data, and cloud platform services.
* **FinOps and optimization:** Lead usage analytics, budget controls, cost allocation, model and API usage optimization, resource right\-sizing, and executive\-level reporting to improve cloud and AI platform cost efficiency.

### **4\. Technical Leadership \& Team Enablement**



Lead and mentor junior engineers by providing hands\-on technical direction, reviewing architecture designs and code, defining reusable engineering patterns, conducting knowledge\-sharing sessions, assigning technical tasks, removing blockers, and ensuring consistent delivery quality across AI platform, GCP, automation, MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps initiatives.


### **5\. MLOps \& LLMOps**



Lead the operationalization of ML, generative AI, and agentic AI solutions across enterprise platforms. This includes MLOps for model deployment, lifecycle management, monitoring, retraining support, and release governance; LLMOps for prompt/version management, model evaluation, RAG quality, safety controls, usage tracking, and responsible AI oversight; and AgentOps for agent workflow observability, tool usage governance, guardrails, incident management, and production support. Ensure AI platforms are secure, observable, cost\-efficient, resilient, and production\-ready.**Overall experience:** 10\-12 years of overall technology experience across cloud engineering, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, automation, enterprise application development, or platform architecture.**Mandatory specialized experience:** 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience as an AI Engineer or AI Platforms Engineer with strong exposure to Google Cloud Platform, MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, and production\-grade AI solution delivery.**GCP technical depth:** Strong experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM, VPC, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Pub/Sub, APIs, service accounts, data pipelines, and enterprise\-grade deployment patterns.**AI platform engineering:** Strong understanding of generative AI, model lifecycle, prompt lifecycle, RAG, embeddings, vector search, model evaluation, responsible AI controls, AI governance, observability, scalability, and platform reliability.**MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps:** Proven experience with model deployment, CI/CD for ML and AI workloads, prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, agent monitoring, tool orchestration, guardrails, usage tracking, incident response, and production support for AI systems.**Core engineering:** Advanced proficiency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, APIs, infrastructure automation, data ingestion pipelines, backend services, and integrations with AI/ML and LLM APIs.**DevOps and platform operations:** Proven experience with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment management, release governance, observability, operational readiness, and production support for enterprise platforms.**Technical leadership:** Proven ability to lead junior engineers, mentor team members, review technical designs and code, define standards, assign technical work, remove blockers, and drive high\-quality delivery.

title: Engineer I - Field Service
description:
### **Job Description**


**Brief Job Description:**



Job Title


**Service Engineer – Precision Air Conditioning (PAC)**



Department



Service Operations – Thermal Management



Reporting To



Service Manager / Regional Service Manager


### **Job Summary**



The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.



Key Responsibilities Installation \& Commissioning


* Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
* Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
* Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
* Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.


Preventive Maintenance


* Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
* Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
* Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.


Breakdown \& Troubleshooting


* Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
* Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
* Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
* Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.


Customer Support


* Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
* Maintain professional communication during service visits.
* Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
* Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign\-off upon activity completion.


Spare Parts \& Inventory Management


* Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
* Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
* Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.


Safety \& Compliance


* Follow all EHS (Environment, Health \& Safety) guidelines.
* Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
* Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
* Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration \& Air Conditioning, or related field.
* ITI (RAC/Electrical) with relevant experience may also be considered.

### **Experience**


* 2 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
* Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.


Technical Skills


* Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
* Experience with:
* Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
* CRAC / CRAH Systems
* Chilled Water Systems
* DX Cooling Systems
* Air\-Cooled and Water\-Cooled Condensers
* CDU and FWU Systems
* Ability to troubleshoot:
* Compressors
* EEV/TEV Valves
* Refrigerant Circuits
* PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
* Electrical Panels and Drives
* Sensors and Communication Networks
* Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.
* Familiarity with BMS and remote monitoring systems.


Key Competencies


* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Customer\-focused approach.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently at remote sites.
* Time management and SLA adherence.
* Teamwork and collaboration.


Key Performance Indicators (KPI)


* Preventive Maintenance Compliance.
* First\-Time Fix Rate (FTFR).
* Breakdown Response Time (RT).
* Turnaround Time (TAT) for call closure.
* Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).
* Service Revenue through spare parts identification.
* Safety Compliance and Zero Incident Record.

### **Travel Requirements**


* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned geographical regions.
* Availability for emergency breakdown support, weekend work, and on\-call duty when required.


Preferred Industry Experience


* Data Centers
* Telecom Facilities
* IT Parks
* Critical Infrastructure Projects
* Pharmaceutical Facilities
* Manufacturing Plants
* Commercial Buildings


**Preferred Certification:** HVAC/R, Refrigerant Handling, Electrical Safety, Working at Height, and OEM\-specific PAC product training (Vertiv, Stulz, Schneider, Rittal, Climaveneta, etc.).


### **About Us**


**The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles \& Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.**


**OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:** Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.


### **OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**


* High\-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength

### **VERTIV BEHAVIORS**


* Own it
* Act with urgency
* Foster a customer\-first mindset
* Think big and execute
* Lead by example
* Drive continuous improvement
* Learn and seek out development
* Promote transparent \& open communication


**About Vertiv**



Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.
